* $155.2 million for the $300 checks
* $38.4 million transferred to the General Fund to fill budget gaps
* $13 million to the Highway Fund for road maintenance
* $5.9 million for "school safety"
* $4.3 million for welfare administration
* $62.5 million into the MaineCare and Education Stabilization sub-funds

The Rainy Day Raid is politically significant only because there has traditionally been a consensus that the Rainy Day Fund should be reserved for... Rainy Days. Things like the Great Recession, Covid-19, or other Black Swan calamities. In reality, the only thing constraining the raid was tradition. That tradition, like the tradition of passing budgets with two-thirds support from lawmakers, is now dead and buried (unless some future Republican coalition decides to resurrect it). Republicans are talking now like they might, in the future, govern with the same degree of ruthlessness that the Mills Administration has, but put me down as a skeptic.
**MaineCare Fraud Bonus:** The Democratic omnibus will include $859 million in combined state and federal matching spending on MaineCare for a single fiscal year, with ~$295M of that projected to be state dollars. (However, that could change, as we'll see later...) The Democratic omnibus contains rate increases targeted at the very programs (Sections 18, 20, 21, 29 in the MaineCare manual) for which the Mills Administration [quietly suspended](https://substack.com/redirect/6048d1ce-a925-4e31-8470-3dfefd42477d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) new provider enrollment last week.

**The Planned Parenthood Fund:** Part Z of the Democrat omnibus is an early Christmas present for the late-term abortion industry. This provision mandates automatic state backfill whenever a Maine Title X "family planning" grantee loses federal funding. That means if the federal government reduces funding for abortion clinics, Maine automatically steps in with dollar-for-dollar replacement from the General Fund, with no legislative appropriation required in future years. The formula is locked to FY 2024-25 federal funding levels as the baseline. The bill also creates an abortion-provider slush fund with explicit legislative intent language directing $5M ongoing annually beginning FY 2027-28 -- an attempt at pre-committing future legislatures to abortion funding. Democrats may technically argue that the language restricts this funding to contraception and gonorrhea tests, but the practical consequence is a windfall for Maine's biggest abortion providers.
The abortion section of this "budget" bill also has an extraordinary change to MaineCare that could have implications far beyond abortion clinics.
In what looks like an attempt to offset Trump Administration changes to allowable reimbursement for abortion providers under Medicaid, the bill directs Maine to substitute state dollars for federal Medicaid matching funds whenever the federal government restricts a specific provider. So if the Trump Administration blocks a given provider from Medicaid, the state will step in and fund it 100 percent from the General Fund, i.e., your tax dollars. Although it seems as if that provision was supposed to apply only to providers like Planned Parenthood, it's written broadly enough to apply to any MaineCare business that the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid (CMS) disqualifies for reimbursement.
In other words, if the Trump Administration decides that all of the autism group homes and the "home care agencies" that have sprung up under Mills are bogus and should not be funded under Medicaid, then Maine taxpayers will automatically be on the hook for the full cost of reimbursing these MaineCare businesses. Unless a provider has been found to have committed fraud under Maine law or otherwise de-authorized by the state (like [Gateway Community Services](https://substack.com/redirect/82687b4d-fe2b-44ce-a3ae-347c2de84593?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Bright Future Healthier You](https://substack.com/redirect/00a234eb-48c5-4525-8a0c-5f702b1ef5ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and [Paradise Residential Services](https://substack.com/redirect/3b755765-feb2-466e-aebe-5ccccd3b1391?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)), Mainers will pay for any withdrawn federal reimbursement.
Here's the wonky detail:
Section Z-5 enacts §3196-A, and this is where the answer gets legally significant. The definition of **" federally unfunded provider"** in subsection 1 reads:
> A health care provider: (A) that is licensed, certified or otherwise authorized by state law to deliver health care services; and (B) that, pursuant to any federal law, the department may not pay using federal funds provided to carry out the state plan under Title XIX of the United States Social Security Act, for items or services provided on or after July 1, 2025 pursuant to federal law.
Even though this provision accompanies the abortion language in the bill, that definition contains no restriction to family planning providers, abortion providers, or any particular provider type. The only requirements are:
1. Licensed in Maine
2. Federally prohibited from receiving Medicaid payment under any federal law

Subsection 2 then mandates that the department reimburse those providers with state funds for "family planning services, as defined by section 1902, subsection 4, and **any other Medicaid-covered items or services lawfully provided to MaineCare members.** "
The phrase "**and any other Medicaid-covered items or services** " is expansive. It is not limited to family planning. It covers the full universe of services that a federally excluded provider is otherwise licensed to deliver to MaineCare members. This bill will effectively cause Maine taxpayers to fund 100 percent of payments to MaineCare agencies that the federal government deems fraudulent. That's a small provision within a big bill, but it could potentially exploded in fiscal consequences for Maine if the Trump Administration's federal fraud task force makes moves to defund MaineCare agencies and the state doesn't cooperate.
Any provider that loses federal Medicaid eligibility due to federal action -- not just family planning providers -- is immediately bailed out by state taxpayers. The law doesn't ask why the federal government cut off the provider, only that it did so by operation of federal law. Conceivably, any provider that loses Medicaid participation due to a future federal policy change targeting any category of service or provider type could trigger this. Immigration-status-related exclusions, for instance, could theoretically trigger this if a provider type is restricted by federal Medicaid rules. The only boundary around the provision is what state law considers "lawful" MaineCare activity.
**SALT Workaround:** Maine is creating a new way for small business owners who file as partnerships or S-corporations to pay their state taxes. Instead of paying taxes as individuals, the business pays the tax directly -- which means the full amount is deductible on federal taxes, getting around the $10,000 federal SALT deduction cap. This is expected to generate $56.5 million in year one but actually costs the state $21 million in year two when everything evens out -- so it's mostly a timing trick that makes year one look better.

Instead of paying taxes as individuals, the business pays the tax directly -- which means the full amount is deductible on federal taxes, getting around the $10,000 federal SALT deduction cap. This is expected to generate $56.5 million in year one but actually costs the state $21 million in year two when everything evens out -- so it's mostly a timing trick that makes year one look better. As we step into 2025, it's the perfect time to reflect on what truly matters when it comes to our health and happiness. Over my three decades as a coach, I've seen countless fads come and go. But the principles that truly transform lives are timeless. At their core, they involve understanding how our bodies respond to signals. The cause-and-effect relationship between what we do and the results we experience. Hormones, adaptation, and biological responses all work together when we give our bodies the right inputs.
This year, I want to challenge you to focus on six pillars of health that will not only improve your physical health but also elevate your mental clarity, happiness, and energy. These six are non-negotiable: Scheduling Time for Yourself, Sleep, Resistance Training, Cardiovascular Conditioning, Nutrition, and Fasting. Master these, and you'll find everything else, like career, family, and relationships, all fall into place.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.bQTjYVffnYSaTunx67cwMBM0Blvx-iP77_qRQ76zR4g?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=193591250)

**1\. Scheduling Time for Yourself: The First Fruits**
Everything begins with intentionality. You can't achieve optimal health if you don't first make time for it. Some call this the "first fruits" of your day. Dedicate time to spend alone in God's Word, prayer, or meditation. You must plan your day. This practice signals to your body and mind that you're in control, setting the tone for everything else that follows.
When you prioritize this quiet time, you're essentially telling your brain and hormones to prepare for productivity and focus. Cortisol, your stress hormone, peaks in the morning--using this time intentionally helps regulate it, keeping you calm and clear-headed throughout the day. Without this scheduled time, life's demands can pull you in every direction, leaving you feeling reactive instead of proactive.
Start small. Even 10-15 minutes of uninterrupted time for reflection, prayer, or planning can make a monumental difference. It's about giving yourself permission to pause, recalibrate, and approach the day with intention.

**2\. Sleep: Your Body 's Recovery Signal**
Sleep is the foundation of health. Without it, nothing else functions optimally. Sleep signals your body to repair, recover, and grow. It regulates hormones like growth hormone and cortisol, restores brain function, and strengthens your immune system.
Aim for 7-9 hours of quality sleep per night. This isn't just about quantity but also quality. Create a sleep sanctuary: keep your room dark, cool, and free from distractions like screens. Turn off Wi-Fi or put your phone into airplane mode. Better yet, charge it outside the room in the bathroom and invest in a manual alarm clock. Guard yourself from EMF. Develop a nighttime routine that signals to your body that it's time to wind down. This might include reading, stretching, or practicing gratitude.
When you prioritize sleep, you'll notice improvements in energy, mood, and even your metabolism. Remember, no amount of caffeine can replace the restorative power of good sleep.

**3\. Resistance Training: The Signal for Strength and Longevity**
If you want to age gracefully and maintain your independence, resistance training must be a priority. Lifting weights signals your body to build and preserve muscle, which is crucial for metabolism, strength, and overall functionality. Muscle is the organ of longevity!
Muscle is a metabolically active tissue that burns calories even at rest. It's also essential for maintaining insulin sensitivity and preventing age-related declines in health. Start with two to three days per week of resistance training, focusing on compound movements like squats, deadlifts, and presses. These exercises recruit multiple muscle groups, maximizing your effort and results. Carrying loads and hangs are essential as well. Walk around your house or block holding dumbbells, and hang from pull-up bars, challenging yourself to hang for 1 minute daily.
Resistance training also improves bone density, reducing the risk of fractures as you age. It's not just about looking good; it's about thriving physically and mentally. The endorphins released during training boost your mood, creating a positive feedback loop that encourages consistency.

**4\. Cardiovascular Conditioning: The Signal for Heart Health**
Your heart is the engine of your body, and cardiovascular conditioning ensures it runs efficiently. Whether it's walking, jogging, cycling, or swimming, consistent cardiovascular exercise signals your body to improve blood flow, oxygen delivery, and endurance.
Cardio doesn't have to mean hours on a treadmill. Find activities you enjoy and aim for at least 150 minutes of moderate-intensity exercise or 75 minutes of vigorous activity per week. This could be as simple as brisk walking or a combination of activities like jumping rope, dancing with friends, or riding your bike.
Remember, cardiovascular exercise also benefits your brain. It stimulates the release of brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF), which supports neuroplasticity and cognitive function. Think of cardio as an investment in both your physical and mental health.

**5\. Nutrition: The Signal for Fuel and Healing**
Food is more than fuel; it's information for your body. Every bite you take signals your cells to act in specific ways. High quality, nutrient dense foods provide the building blocks your body needs to repair, grow, and thrive.
Focus on whole foods: grass-fed meat, wild caught fish, range-free organic eggs, healthy fats like avocados and olive oil, and fiber-rich carbohydrates like vegetables, fruits, and ancient grains. Avoid highly processed foods and inflammatory seed oils. Remember, what you eat directly impacts your gut health, hormone balance, and energy levels. Would you rather your body be fueled by Skittles or Apples?!
Plan your meals ahead of time to ensure you're consistently nourishing your body. Eat like your ancestors did, not like modern grade school kids.
Consistency is key. When you provide your body with the right signals through nutrition, you'll notice improved digestion, mental clarity, and sustained energy throughout the day.

**6\. Fasting: The Signal for Healing and Renewal**
Fasting is one of the most powerful tools for health and longevity. By giving your digestive system a break, you signal your body to enter a state of repair and renewal. This process, known as autophagy, clears out damaged cells and promotes the production of new, healthy ones.
Intermittent fasting, where you eat within a specific time window (e.g., 8 hours) and fast for the remaining 16, is a simple way to incorporate this practice. However, as the Founder of Fast.Eat.Live., I'd encourage you to inquire about our proprietary fasting method. I believe it's a far superior approach that prioritizes both mental and physical benefits, optimizing autophagy while matching your lifestyle.
Fasting improves insulin sensitivity, supports gut health, and enhances mental clarity. It's not about deprivation but about giving your body the time, it needs to heal and reset. Give yourself the gift of health.

**Bringing It All Together**
These six pillars: Scheduling Time for Yourself, Sleep, Resistance Training, Cardiovascular Conditioning, Nutrition, and Fasting are the foundation of optimal health in 2025. When you master these, everything else in your life benefits. You'll have the energy to excel in your career, the stamina to enjoy time with family and friends, and the resilience to face life's challenges with a positive attitude.
Change doesn't happen overnight, but it starts with small, intentional steps. Pick one or two areas to focus on this month and build from there. Remember, your body responds to the signals you give it. Be consistent, stay disciplined, and watch as your health transforms this year.

As your coach, I'm here to guide and support you every step of the way. Let's make 2025 the year you take control of your health and live your best life. Here's to a happier, healthier you!

name: Wes Moore
subject: A more just system
body:
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1261%2E1086043%2E461GGX)
On June 17th, 2024, I pardoned 175,000 misdemeanor cannabis convictions.
Peter, it was the largest mass pardon for misdemeanor cannabis possession in the history of the United States.
But making history wasn’t the point -- making life better for Marylanders was. _You cannot celebrate legalization without reckoning with the consequences of criminalization._
It was one of the most moving days I’ve had as governor. **But no matter how important that moment was for the people of our state,****I can’t shake a deep feeling that the consequences of misused pardons might outweigh the benefits.**
The ability for an elected official to wipe clean someone’s criminal record is powerful.
But what do we do with a tool that can simultaneously advance and roll back the cause of justice, depending on who issues the pardon?
Can make our system more fair in the hands of one person, and less fair in the hands of another?
Donald Trump has pardoned the people who attempted a coup on January 6th, 2021. He has pardoned high-profile business magnates who have a stake in his family’s financial interests. He has pardoned allies and associates, often doling out clemency based on who is most loyal.
**It is disgusting. It is a grift.**
As thankful as I am to be one of only fifty-one people in the world who can pardon an American for crimes committed in violation of our laws, I would take it from all of us if it’s only going to be used for self-dealing and political gamesmanship.
Pardons can right the wrongs of the past. I know that they have here in Maryland. We’ve used the pardon to uplift those who have been denied justice.
But the thing is: Pardons do little to actually fix the foundation of what’s broken. Maybe instead of more pardons, _what we need is a more just system._
One where individuals are held fully accountable for their actions, but where honest second chances are possible for those ready to return to society and contribute.
I discussed this and more with Steve Inskeep on NPR -- [**if you’re interested, you can take a listen here.**](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/1340?t=2&akid=1261%2E1086043%2E461GGX)
Elevate,
Wes

History is not repeating itself exactly, but the warning signs are unmistakable.

They need a city where the rich -- and everyone else -- **actually want to stay.** They need leaders who understand that competitiveness is not a dirty word; it is the only way to keep the lights on and the paychecks coming.

| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

body:
Hi there — Michael Bennet here.

After spending almost 17 years fighting for Colorado’s working families in the Senate, I often get asked why I’m running for governor. The answer is simpler than you might think:

Right now, GOP majorities in Congress are letting Trump’s chaos, corruption and cruelty run wild. They’re failing to rein in the massive corporations hiking prices and lowering our quality of life.

Meanwhile, Trump’s revenge campaign against blue states has left Colorado hanging out to dry.

So right now, I’m running to take the fight for Colorado’s working families where I can make the biggest possible impact: **here in our home state.**

**_[That's why I'm asking you to donate $10, split between Maggie Hassan and myself, toward my campaign's $100,000 public reporting goal (our biggest one yet)](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129056968/613140704/-2019546268?amount=10&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.04.08_Michael-Bennet-Split_B1_F1_S1_C1_90OP_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMzM5MWE2ZS03MzMzLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yMZiLU_IQCdb6lggZwEtalL1y-8XOiUuO2u_mMj9x6U=)_** — because Colorado deserves a leader who will unite folks to tackle our biggest challenges and deliver real change.

I'm the only guy with the hands-on experience and the values and bold vision to lead our state out of Trump’s second Gilded Age.

I’m also the _only_ one with tangible plans to improve Coloradans' lives, like:

🏘️ Cutting red tape to build more starter homes and affordable housing options
🩺 Creating a Colorado Public Option to expand affordable health care access

body:
Help us ensure that every eligible Texan can vote this November.
#
Millions of Texans are at risk of being kicked off the voter rolls.
Texas governor Greg Abbott handed over our state’s full voter list to Trump’s Department of Justice—including names, dates of birth, driver’s license numbers, and the last four digits of Social Security numbers for over 18 million Texans.
It’s almost certain that Trump will use this private, personal information to illegally purge voters just months or even weeks before November’s elections.
Millions of Texans could have their voices silenced as Trump decisively rigs the election in his favor.
**That’s where Powered by People steps in.**
**[SIGN UP TODAY ››](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22629?source=em20260408-1605&t=1&akid=1605%2E2118727%2EGGFVkg)**
We’re standing up to Trump and fighting this voter suppression by organizing in every part of Texas, personally meeting and building personal relationships with those most likely to be targeted by these purges and stepping in when they are threatened with removal. But we can’t do it alone.
[**Sign up to join our effort to stop Trump from stealing this election — and stay in touch with Powered by People as we work together to fight voter suppression and ensure that we win critical elections across Texas.**](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22629?source=em20260408-1605&t=2&akid=1605%2E2118727%2EGGFVkg)
Be part of one of the largest grassroots organizing efforts in Texas history. Whether you can volunteer, register voters, show up at events, or simply stay connected and help spread the word, there is a role for you—and we need you in this fight, now more than ever.
Thank you,
Beto

[I hope this email finds you well. Where else on the planet can a big-city real estate guy and a small-town hillbilly team up to bring down a political machine to become the leader of the free world and his right hand?
The answer is nowhere but the Shining City on a Hill.
But just like President Reagan, I believe in my heart of hearts that freedom is always a generation away from extinction.
So while I'll never forget Election Night 2024, my sights are set squarely on Election Night 2026.
That's because EVERYTHING comes down to the midterm elections. If the Democrats win back control of Congress, everything we've worked so hard for comes to a SCREECHING HALT!
That's why the Democrat Machine is mobilizing earlier, faster, and more powerfully than anyone thought possible. And we're in for a shellacking if we don't get our act together. Why? Because the Democrats are...
- Unleashing swarms of attack ads in every swing district - just like 2024- Plastering the media with anti-Trump propaganda - just like all last year- Weaponizing the Deep State to undermine us - just par for the course- Suing us in court to hamstring our agenda - just like Joe Biden did- Tracking to rake in a billion (with a "b") dollars - just like Kamala Harris
They're throwing the kitchen sink at us because everyone knows they can't win on the issues. The American People rejected their agenda of open borders, hostility toward cops, divisive DEI programming, transgender activism, and hating the freest country on Earth.
It's a losing message. I know it. You know it. And they know it too.
That's why the Democrats resort to the ugly, gutter-level politics that pits Americans against each other. They divide so they can conquer.
And the only way they win is if too many Conservatives in our movement rest on our laurels.
The so-called "experts" say that the Democrat Party is fired up and MAGA will sit out this election without Donald Trump on the ballot.

He sent his ICE army to attack our neighbors and deployed the National Guard on communities. He has kidnapped the president of Venezuela. He threatened to invade our ally, Greenland. And this week, Donald Trump threatened to wipe Iran off the map.
Donald Trump needs to be stopped.
Every person in Donald Trump’s cabinet, his advisors, the Speaker of the House, and every Member of Congress has an obligation to refuse to carry out illegal orders like Trump’s threat to annihilate Iran.
He needs to be removed, either by impeachment or invoking the 25th Amendment, before more American and Iranian lives are lost to Trump’s war of choice.
Republicans must not just throw up their hands and cave in to Trump—the GOP holds the majority in both chambers of Congress, the White House, and, one could argue, the Supreme Court. They have the power to stop Donald Trump before he prolongs his war of choice and causes more bloodshed.
The time has come for Republicans to stand up to Trump or get out of the way of the leaders who are ready to govern and protect Americans, not use our soldiers as pieces on a chessboard.
I am calling on my colleagues in the House to start impeachment proceedings immediately. I’m calling on you for help to support our movement and get Donald Trump—and all who allow his cruelty—out of office. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_med_email-26q2?refcode=x_260408_TrumpIran_act]

## If Americans Are Asked to Borrow for College, They Deserve the Truth
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5bfc74a7-4b22-4690-b96f-a5b6b5b9ef4b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
America does not just have a student debt problem.
[Pledge your support](https://substack..bz24G0pfcudPP2CnWFeqmVWoAsvlTmD9uemdioirxHY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=193594926)
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1454853&post_id=193594926&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTkzNTk0OTI2LCJpYXQiOjE3NzU2NzQ2MzksImV4cCI6MTc3ODI2NjYzOSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTE0NTQ4NTMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.pSdsMbkbFDaaOHwD1v-OVAM5VadlpK92crJGO29RIQ0)
America has a **transparency problem**.
For years, young people have been told the same story: go to college, borrow what you need, and opportunity will take care of the rest. But the federal government's own College Scorecard exists because debt, earnings, and field-of-study outcomes are measurable, and the New York Fed's labor-market tracker shows those outcomes vary sharply across graduates. ([College Scorecard](https://substack.com/redirect/72c965d4-0d7d-4acd-8a2d-86030ac3d265?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
That is why America needs a **Truth in Education Act**.
The idea is simple: if an 18-year-old is going to sign for years of debt, colleges should have to disclose, in plain English and before borrowing, what the degree costs, what graduates typically earn, how often they are underemployed, and where tuition dollars actually go. College Scorecard already publishes part of this picture, but it is still not a single, universal, easy-to-read "before you borrow" disclosure sheet based on your degree.
## We Learned This Lesson After the Housing Crisis
After the 2008 financial crisis, policymakers moved toward clearer disclosure for major debts because Americans were taking on obligations they did not fully understand.
**The Crisis modified the Truth In Lending Act (1968) with a "Know Before you Owe" modification. **If we believed homebuyers deserved clearer disclosure before signing a mortgage, students deserve clearer disclosure before signing for education debt.
_**A student loan is not symbolic. It shapes where someone can live, what job they can take, whether they can save, and when they can start a family. That is the same consumer-protection logic behind modern lending transparency. It is an investment in an institution and they also deserve to know how the school manages that investment for the maximum return on human capital.**_
Higher education is starting to get an earnings-warning system through the Dept. of Education in the [FAFSA process](https://substack.com/redirect/2ce1fba2-5908-49d0-a5a1-ec59187d2316?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but America still lacks a true consumer-disclosure standard for college debt based on degree type.
## What the Truth in Education Act Would Require
Every college and university participating in federal student aid should provide a simple program-level disclosure sheet before enrollment and before borrowing. That disclosure should show:
* average annual cost
* average debt at graduation
* median earnings
* job placement rates based on degree
* underemployment rates
* expected break-even timeline
* and a plain breakdown of where tuition and institutional spending actually go

This is not anti-college.
It is pro-truth.
If a degree is worth the price, the school should be able to prove it.
## What College Costs?
The U.S. Department of Education's College Scorecard (which is on the lowside of college costs) shows a midpoint for 4-year colleges of about **$20,081 per year** , which implies roughly **$80,000+ over four years** before financing costs or opportunity cost. ([College Scorecard](https://substack.com/redirect/a2523b30-9ff8-457a-bce3-7d699020c7cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7948f4b1-7943-45e5-a5c1-15e40369b2e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
That is exactly why "just trust us" or everyone need a college degree is not enough.
## The Outcome Gap
The New York Fed reports that labor-market conditions for recent college graduates worsened at the end of 2025. Recent graduate unemployment was about **5.7%** in Q4 2025, while underemployment rose to **42.5%**. ([Federal Reserve Bank of New York](https://substack.com/redirect/9c3b5e24-c3b1-4dc7-a6c8-c241c28e2236?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/82c0ff0d-2b84-487c-bdc2-f9b6de58e160?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
That does not mean college is inherently bad.
_**It means the system should stop pretending every degree delivers the same return on the same tuition cost for a 4-year degree absent some difference in book costs etc.**_
_**Underemployment is critical as it means that the degree is not being used by the graduate in a significant way.**_
## Not All Degrees Lead To the Same Outcome
Some degrees lead to strong wages and direct job pipelines. Others do not. College Scorecard and the New York Fed both make clear that outcomes differ widely by school and field of study. ([College Scorecard](https://substack.com/redirect/72c965d4-0d7d-4acd-8a2d-86030ac3d265?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
_That is why students deserve to compare likely debt and likely earnings before they borrow, not after they graduate._
## College Versus the Trades and Getting a Headstart on Earning
The Bureau of Labor Statistics reports median annual pay of **$62,350** for electricians, **$62,970** for plumbers, pipefitters, and steamfitters, and **$59,810** for HVAC mechanics and installers in May 2024. These are serious careers with solid wages and far lower training costs than many four-year degrees. ([Bureau of Labor Statistics](https://substack.com/redirect/930c17c1-4e8a-462b-8916-77278d556cfc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bd57352b-6165-4abf-a3f7-e1e3b7c0aad6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
`
`This is not an argument against college.
It is an argument for honest comparison, especially for those who think college is the only path to financial freedom
## Mike Rowe was Early. The market is catching up.
Mike Rowe has spent years arguing that America undersells the trades and oversells the four-year degree path. His [mikeroweWORKS Foundation ](https://substack.com/redirect/3289fd89-c361-4350-8b4f-273ebadc6bcf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)promotes training for skilled work because these jobs are essential, in demand, and often do not require massive debt.
## Even Lowe's is Getting Involved
Now the private sector is putting real money behind that argument. On April 7, 2026, _Fortune_ reported that Lowe's said it will invest **$250 million over the next decade** to help train **250,000 skilled trade workers** in areas like plumbing, carpentry, and electrical work. Lowe's CEO Marvin Ellison said the trades are "critical to the future."
That matters
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8fc05256-4ca6-4c6a-8f83-d832c5d0fa09?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Because it shows the market already understands something the education system still resists: not every path to prosperity runs through a four-year degree.
## `
Message from the market:
"We need more builders, fixers, installers, and makers."
`
If major employers are investing at that scale in skilled trade training, students deserve to see that reality side by side with college borrowing decisions. ([Fortune](https://substack.com/redirect/ca935362-5fed-403b-9501-e804b121f1e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
## Where does your tuition actually go?
Students deserve not only outcome transparency, but spending transparency. National Center for Education Statistics data show that for **public 4-year institutions** in 2020-21, instruction accounted for **34%** of core expenses, while for **private nonprofit 4-year institutions** , instruction accounted for **39%** and academic support, student services, and institutional support together accounted for **40%**. ([College Scorecard](https://substack.com/redirect/f3bc0152-abb2-4de3-86cb-ef203ce3b814?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
That means many families are paying for much more than classroom instruction.
They should be told what that mix looks like.
## Follow the Tuition Dollar
A Truth in Education Act should require schools to translate those categories into plain English: how much goes to instruction, administration, student services, facilities, athletics where applicable, debt service, and overhead.
Because if students are borrowing for an education, they should know what they are actually financing.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1af98463-ea16-4bee-80a2-60a0308a9eaf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
## The Question Every Student Deserves to Ask
Before borrowing, every student should be able to ask one simple question:
**What is the economic value of this degree?**
And the school should have to answer with data.
Not branding.
Not vibes.
Not prestige.
Data.
## Why This Matters for America
This is not just a personal finance issue.
It affects homeownership, family formation, workforce mobility, and long-term resilience. When students take on debt without clear outcomes, the damage spreads beyond the borrower. The New York Fed's recent graduate data make that hard to ignore, and the growing demand for skilled work makes the comparison even more urgent. ([Federal Reserve Bank of New York](https://substack.com/redirect/9c3b5e24-c3b1-4dc7-a6c8-c241c28e2236?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
Debt without transparency does not just burden students.
It weakens the country.
## The Bottom Line
The Truth in Education Act is not about attacking universities.
It is about ending the double standard.
We demanded clearer disclosure after the housing crisis because the stakes were too high for blind trust.
The stakes are high here too.
If a school wants a young American to borrow tens of thousands of dollars, that school should have to disclose:
* what the degree costs
* what graduates typically earn
* how often graduates are underemployed
* how long it takes to break even
* and where the tuition money actually goes

That is not anti-education.
That is honesty.
That is consumer protection.
That is treating students like adults before asking them to sign adult-sized debt.

clean_body: Let's Stop Failing the Future | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more The Goldstein Substack - A Father-Son Publication Dr. Goldstein is Running for Congress and his page can be found Let's Stop Failing the Future | | and | Apr 8 | | | ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | If Americans Are Asked to Borrow for College, They Deserve the Truth | | ---|---|--- America does not just have a student debt problem. America has a transparency problem. For years, young people have been told the same story: go to college, borrow what you need, and opportunity will take care of the rest. But the federal government's own College Scorecard exists because debt, earnings, and field-of-study outcomes are measurable, and the New York Fed's labor-market tracker shows those outcomes vary sharply across graduates. () That is why America needs a Truth in Education Act. The idea is simple: if an 18-year-old is going to sign for years of debt, colleges should have to disclose, in plain English and before borrowing, what the degree costs, what graduates typically earn, how often they are underemployed, and where tuition dollars actually go. College Scorecard already publishes part of this picture, but it is still not a single, universal, easy-to-read "before you borrow" disclosure sheet based on your degree. We Learned This Lesson After the Housing Crisis After the 2008 financial crisis, policymakers moved toward clearer disclosure for major debts because Americans were taking on obligations they did not fully understand. The Crisis modified the Truth In Lending Act (1968) with a "Know Before you Owe" modification. If we believed homebuyers deserved clearer disclosure before signing a mortgage, students deserve clearer disclosure before signing for education debt. A student loan is not symbolic. It shapes where someone can live, what job they can take, whether they can save, and when they can start a family. That is the same consumer-protection logic behind modern lending transparency. It is an investment in an institution and they also deserve to know how the school manages that investment for the maximum return on human capital. Higher education is starting to get an earnings-warning system through the Dept. of Education in the , but America still lacks a true consumer-disclosure standard for college debt based on degree type. What the Truth in Education Act Would Require Every college and university participating in federal student aid should provide a simple program-level disclosure sheet before enrollment and before borrowing. That disclosure should show: average annual cost average debt at graduation median earnings job placement rates based on degree underemployment rates expected break-even timeline and a plain breakdown of where tuition and institutional spending actually go This is not anti-college. It is pro-truth. If a degree is worth the price, the school should be able to prove it. What College Costs? The U.S. Department of Education's College Scorecard (which is on the lowside of college costs) shows a midpoint for 4-year colleges of about $20,081 per year , which implies roughly $80,000+ over four years before financing costs or opportunity cost. () | | ---|---|--- That is exactly why "just trust us" or everyone need a college degree is not enough. The Outcome Gap The New York Fed reports that labor-market conditions for recent college graduates worsened at the end of 2025. Recent graduate unemployment was about 5.7% in Q4 2025, while underemployment rose to 42.5%. () | | ---|---|--- That does not mean college is inherently bad. It means the system should stop pretending every degree delivers the same return on the same tuition cost for a 4-year degree absent some difference in book costs etc. Underemployment is critical as it means that the degree is not being used by the graduate in a significant way. Not All Degrees Lead To the Same Outcome Some degrees lead to strong wages and direct job pipelines. Others do not. College Scorecard and the New York Fed both make clear that outcomes differ widely by school and field of study. () That is why students deserve to compare likely debt and likely earnings before they borrow, not after they graduate. College Versus the Trades and Getting a Headstart on Earning The Bureau of Labor Statistics reports median annual pay of $62,350 for electricians, $62,970 for plumbers, pipefitters, and steamfitters, and $59,810 for HVAC mechanics and installers in May 2024. These are serious careers with solid wages and far lower training costs than many four-year degrees. () | | ---|---|--- ` `This is not an argument against college. It is an argument for honest comparison, especially for those who think college is the only path to financial freedom Mike Rowe was Early. The market is catching up. Mike Rowe has spent years arguing that America undersells the trades and oversells the four-year degree path. His training for skilled work because these jobs are essential, in demand, and often do not require massive debt. Even Lowe's is Getting Involved Now the private sector is putting real money behind that argument. On April 7, 2026, Fortune reported that Lowe's said it will invest $250 million over the next decade to help train 250,000 skilled trade workers in areas like plumbing, carpentry, and electrical work. Lowe's CEO Marvin Ellison said the trades are "critical to the future." That matters | | ---|---|--- Because it shows the market already understands something the education system still resists: not every path to prosperity runs through a four-year degree. ` Message from the market: "We need more builders, fixers, installers, and makers." ` If major employers are investing at that scale in skilled trade training, students deserve to see that reality side by side with college borrowing decisions. () Where does your tuition actually go? Students deserve not only outcome transparency, but spending transparency. National Center for Education Statistics data show that for public 4-year institutions in 2020-21, instruction accounted for 34% of core expenses, while for private nonprofit 4-year institutions , instruction accounted for 39% and academic support, student services, and institutional support together accounted for 40%. () That means many families are paying for much more than classroom instruction. They should be told what that mix looks like. Follow the Tuition Dollar A Truth in Education Act should require schools to translate those categories into plain English: how much goes to instruction, administration, student services, facilities, athletics where applicable, debt service, and overhead. Because if students are borrowing for an education, they should know what they are actually financing. | | ---|---|--- The Question Every Student Deserves to Ask Before borrowing, every student should be able to ask one simple question: What is the economic value of this degree? And the school should have to answer with data. Not branding. Not vibes. Not prestige. Data. Why This Matters for America This is not just a personal finance issue. It affects homeownership, family formation, workforce mobility, and long-term resilience. When students take on debt without clear outcomes, the damage spreads beyond the borrower. The New York Fed's recent graduate data make that hard to ignore, and the growing demand for skilled work makes the comparison even more urgent. () Debt without transparency does not just burden students. It weakens the country. The Bottom Line The Truth in Education Act is not about attacking universities. It is about ending the double standard. We demanded clearer disclosure after the housing crisis because the stakes were too high for blind trust. The stakes are high here too. If a school wants a young American to borrow tens of thousands of dollars, that school should have to disclose: what the degree costs what graduates typically earn how often graduates are underemployed how long it takes to break even * and where the tuition money actually goes That is not anti-education. That is honesty. That is consumer protection. That is treating students like adults before asking them to sign adult-sized debt. Colorado lawmakers move to sidestep Supreme Court ruling on therapy speech
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends!
Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). And also, check out our [deep-dive video of the day](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) on the deepening drought in Colorado & what may be making it worse.
Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏛️ **Under the Golden Dome...** Lawmakers are advancing major policy changes, including a bill to [elevate certain fatal driving cases to felonies](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), a [$46.8 billion budget](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) shaped by rising Medicaid costs, and a [first-in-the-nation law](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) limiting arrests based solely on unreliable drug tests. Debate also continues over [proposals tied to parental rights](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), religious freedom, and [free speech following a recent Supreme Court ruling](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** A new poll shows [unaffiliated voters now make up about half the electorate](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), with most choosing that status intentionally. In the Secretary of State race, Republican candidates are pushing election reforms ranging from [voter roll audits](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to []()[eliminating electronic voting machines](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), while [new tools are emerging](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to improve transparency in state spending.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Homeland Security is considering [ending international flights to sanctuary cities](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) by removing federal customs officers, citing enforcement concerns, while NASA’s Artemis II mission has [set a record by traveling more than 252,000 miles from Earth](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and offering rare views of the moon’s far side.
This is your Mountain Minute for Wednesday, April 8, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Colorado lawmakers move to sidestep Supreme Court ruling on therapy speech](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [SEY ANYTHING](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_The U.S. Supreme Court ruled on March 31, 2026, in Chiles v. Salazar (8-1 decision, with Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson dissenting) that Colorado’s 2019 ban on “conversion therapy” for minors violates the First Amendment’s free-speech protections as applied to talk therapy._
_The Supreme Court’s ruling said the Colorado law was unconstitutional because it constituted “viewpoint discrimination.” The Supreme Court made it clear that talk therapy is protected speech, not “conduct.”_
_But Colorado refuses to accept the Supreme Court’s ruling. Instead, the insane state that I live in (because I was trying to escape the insanity of California!) has immediately implemented a work around. Yes that’s right. Colorado Democrats decided to double down._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[What Sets J.J. McKinzie Apart in Colorado’s Secretary of State Race](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Business-focused candidate emphasizes accountability:** J.J. McKinzie highlights his private-sector background and says government lacks the results-driven accountability expected in business, positioning himself as a systems-focused reformer.

* **Election integrity reforms front and center:** He is calling to end automatic voter registration, conduct a full audit of voter rolls, and cross-check registrations with federal and state databases to improve accuracy and oversight.

* **Push for major structural changes to voting system:** McKinzie argues universal mail-in voting has inherent vulnerabilities and supports replacing it with a more verifiable system, while also advocating greater transparency and cooperation with federal election oversight.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[From Kazakhstan to Colorado: Secretary of State candidate James Wiley’s plan to scrap electronic voting machines](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Candidate emphasizes election integrity overhaul:** Secretary of State candidate James Wiley is calling to eliminate electronic voting machines and replace them with hand-counted paper ballots conducted at local voting centers to improve transparency and trust.

* **Background shaped by global experience and election work:** Wiley points to his upbringing in Kazakhstan and six years working on election-related cases in Colorado as key influences behind his focus on accountability and safeguarding election systems.

* **Push for transparency and public accountability:** He supports releasing records tied to past election controversies, including the Tina Peters case, and argues greater public access and participation are needed to restore confidence in the process.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[Colorado’s ‘politically homeless’ voters: Who’s showing up—and who’s not](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY RMV STAFF | STATE | APRIL 6** _Erin Brantley doesn’t see Colorado politics from a campaign office or a party meeting. She sees it in real time—through thousands of conversations with voters who aren’t sure where they belong, or whether their vote even matters._
**[A system under scrutiny: Colorado’s election system faces clash over how it’s verified](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | APRIL 6** _When President Trump signed an executive order directing federal agencies to compile a nationwide citizenship list and share it with state election officials, it set off a debate in Colorado that hasn’t slowed. So what does that actually mean for Colorado? RMV asked two people on opposite sides of the issue—and got two very different answers._
__
**[El Paso Co. found a way to cut undeliverable ballots and clean voter rolls—Colorado leaders looked away](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY BOB COOPER | COMMENTARY | APRIL 6** _This story should get your attention and maybe even make you angry if you care about election integrity issues—or simply about wasting taxpayer dollars in every county in Colorado. Get this: El Paso County has been implementing a common-sense voter roll maintenance process, a true “Gold Standard” process, to reduce election costs and clean up the “dirty,” bloated voter rolls._
__

body:
He actually sounds alright. He helped pass a bill back in 2023 preventing any president from unilaterally withdrawing from NATO.
#

Hey, have you guys ever heard of this Marco Rubio guy?
He actually sounds alright. He helped pass a bill back in 2023 preventing any president from unilaterally withdrawing from NATO.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-apr26.ZLvc4O&refcode=em260408-1-90&t=1&akid=4112%2E734936%2Ep7i1Fs)
But, wait. I wonder what Marco’s up to now?
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-apr26.ZLvc4O&refcode=em260408-1-90&t=2&akid=4112%2E734936%2Ep7i1Fs)
Wow. You know, if you look closely, you can almost see where he used to keep all his principles before he got rid of them to work for Trump.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-apr26.ZLvc4O&refcode=em260408-1-90&t=3&akid=4112%2E734936%2Ep7i1Fs)
Sad.
Peter, what’s actually really crazy is that almost every elected Republican in Washington, DC is like this. They know Trump is nuts. They know this goes against everything they used to believe. But they also know their careers will be over in an instant if they say anything against Trump in public.
Being elected by your constituents is a huge responsibility. It’s one I take seriously, and it’s one of the greatest honors of my life that the people of Arizona sent me to the Senate to fight for them.
I know your support helped put me here. So, I just wanted to say thank you.
It means a lot to have you with me.
Semper Fi,
Ruben

Lately, I've been doing some reflecting on my grandfather, President John F. Kennedy, and his legacy of hope.
In my run to fight for NY-12 in Congress, and just as a person, that's what I want to focus on. Hope.
My name is Jack, or John Bouvier Kennedy Schlossberg if you want to know the whole thing.
In high school, I spent hours watching my grandfather's speeches. He taught us all that politics isn't about serving yourself — it's about serving others. When we fight for hope, we're not just doing it for ourselves, we're doing it for each other and the future we all have to share.
I know I have big shoes to fill. In my grandfather's memory, I've led a life of caring about this a lot. I put that care and effort and hope into everything I do.
But this is bigger than me. It's bigger than my family's legacy.
Hope is hard to find in Politics these days, but if we let it die out completely, that's how we really lose. Now cannot be the time to stop caring or turn away. We have to double down in our pursuit of hope.
I really think this election is the one — our last chance to stop Trump and change the direction we're heading in.
I need you to know that I believe we can do it. I believe in hope, and I believe in us. Will you believe with me? clean_body: [] Lately, I've been doing some reflecting on my grandfather, President John F. Kennedy, and his legacy of hope. In my run to fight for NY-12 in Congress, and just as a person, that's what I want to focus on. Hope. My name is Jack, or John Bouvier Kennedy Schlossberg if you want to know the whole thing. In high school, I spent hours watching my grandfather's speeches. He taught us all that politics isn't about serving yourself — it's about serving others. When we fight for hope, we're not just doing it for ourselves, we're doing it for each other and the future we all have to share. I know I have big shoes to fill. In my grandfather's memory, I've led a life of caring about this a lot. I put that care and effort and hope into everything I do. But this is bigger than me. It's bigger than my family's legacy. Hope is hard to find in Politics these days, but if we let it die out completely, that's how we really lose. Now cannot be the time to stop caring or turn away. We have to double down in our pursuit of hope. I really think this election is the one — our last chance to stop Trump and change the direction we're heading in. I need you to know that I believe we can do it. I believe in hope, and I believe in us. Will you believe with me? You can make a difference by splitting a donation between our campaign for NY-12 and Resist Reclaim Rebuild today >> [] [] CHIP IN TODAY! | | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

Friends, this changes everything:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0f0767ff-ea9a-40c9-b6f2-ba16c4f3a89f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Let me break it down for you ...
First, Donald Trump won Michigan in 2024, and then _The Hill_ warned that our state was one of the most likely to flip red this November.
NRSC chair Tim Scott even went on national television to declare, "We are going to win in Michigan."
Then, Trump launched his dangerous and illegal war in Iran. Gas prices started soaring across Michigan. And the stock market started spiraling, sending ripples of fear about a possible recession.
_And with that, Trump 's grip on power began teetering._
**[Now, Michigan's open seat is primed and ready for us to win and deliver Democrats a Senate majority that we were told was nearly impossible only a couple of months ago.](https://substack.com/redirect/fd4f5c17-3c41-4868-adab-620d322cd0b1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Headlines like this one, that remind the whole country just how crucial our race is, energize me and fill me with hope.
But I've gotta be honest: We're not the only ones watching these headlines.
Mike Rogers, the NRSC, and their MAGA allies are paying close attention. They're ready to use any and every chance they can find to fire up their far-right billionaire base.
And a headline like this one? It's a pretty big opportunity.
There's a flood of GOP spending on the way - **$45 MILLION to be clear** - and we need to be ready for it.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a4445574-9dfa-48c7-b972-ac93089339bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
That's why I need grassroots Democrats like you on my side now more than ever. Momentum is on our side, but it's going to take all of us coming together to make sure we can build on it.
**[So if you're able, will you rush a gift now so I can keep up this momentum, take on MAGA's millions, and win this race for all of us in November?](https://substack.com/redirect/fd4f5c17-3c41-4868-adab-620d322cd0b1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Let's do this,
Haley
* * *

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/fd4f5c17-3c41-4868-adab-620d322cd0b1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

name: Jim Jordan
subject: I’ll never accuse you of abandoning us
body:
After all you’ve done for our Party, I salute you, Peter!
| Peter,
---
I’m sick of seeing text messages that accuse you of abandoning the GOP after all you’ve done for us.
---
All because you didn’t give $15 before some random deadline, that’s supposed to mean you **_“betrayed”_** the Republican Party and became a Democrat?
---
So all the times you stood in line to vote, you knocked on doors, you put up a yard sign, you made phone calls, you filled out surveys, you sacrificed your time and money – suddenly, all of that means nothing?
---
**_Give me a break! That’s just insulting._**
---
_Hand to God, I will never stoop to that low._
---
Truth be told, I try not to write too many emails and texts as it is. I’m busy working in Washington to do the job you asked me to do.
---
Honestly, fundraising just isn’t Priority #1.
---
At the end of 2024, I transferred $2.5 MILLION _**away**_ from my own campaign to help conservatives in tough races who _truly_ needed help.
---
**You know what I care about most?** The _ONLY_ thing that WINS elections – **_VOTES_**.
---
_That means registering voters, verifying every Trump voter’s profile, and constantly getting LIVE feedback from voters like you so that the President and I _always_ have the best, most accurate data in the country._
---
That’s how we won in 2024. And it’s my plan to win AGAIN in 2026.
---

| | Friend, When I was elected, I promised to put people first and deliver for Maryland, and that’s what I’m doing. I’m proud that my very first bill to pass the House, **the MAWS Act** , was a very Maryland bill in every sense. **This bipartisan legislation tackles one of the biggest threats to the Bay: invasive blue catfish. ** These predators are a threat to the Chesapeake Bay’s ecosystems. They’re eating up our blue crabs, rockfish, and oysters — the backbone of the $100 billion Bay economy that supports hundreds of watermen and businesses across the state. I’m doing my part by ordering blue catfish when it's on the menu in Annapolis, but the reality is that we can’t just simply eat our way out of this problem. Without intervention, our watermen and ecosystem remain at risk. **The MAWS Act is a pragmatic solution that I was proud to have co-led with my colleagues, Representatives Wittman, Kiggans, and Hoyer.** This bill will:
* **Create new markets:** provide NOAA with funding to facilitate a market for blue catfish in the pet and animal food industry.
* **Fairly compensate watermen:** ensure watermen are paid for catching blue catfish of all sizes — current regulations mean only fish under 25 pounds are processed for human consumption.
* **Gather information for future waterways:** collect and analyze data on the impact of invasive blue catfish on the ecology and economy of the Bay, and analyze the impact of this pilot program.

We spent a year crafting this bill, holding over 100 meetings with local watermen, processors, scientists, and so many more to ensure that everyone had a seat at the table. I’ve always believed that leadership is listening — no one should be left out of the decisions that are shaping our future. In a time when Washington feels more divided than ever, we proved that when it comes to the health of the Chesapeake Bay, we can still find common ground. _**[I’m proud of this win, but the work continues as we move this bill into the Senate. body:
Demi Palecek just won her primary a few weeks ago — here’s why corporate super PACs tried to take her out.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260408-1&t=1&akid=3348%2E587540%2E58QkCy)
Peter,
Demi Palecek just won her primary last month, and I want to tell you exactly why corporate super PACs spent hundreds of thousands of dollars trying to stop her.
The answer will tell you _everything_ about who and what she’s really up against.
Here’s what’s been happening in Illinois:
Last fall, Illinois passed a new tax on sports betting. A per-bet tax that hit DraftKings and FanDuel the hardest. Sports betting in the state dropped 15% almost overnight, and the companies’ stock value tanked.
So what did they do in response? They decided to try and buy the Illinois state legislature.
**DraftKings funneled over $1.2 million into Illinois Democratic primaries through a super PAC called “American Future” with a simple goal — handpick candidates who would get rid of the sports betting tax and protect their profits. Even at the cost of millions of young people who have become addicted to gambling.**
One of the candidates they bankrolled was Adam Braun, a lawyer working for a corporate firm that represents DraftKings and FanDuel. He ran against Demi in her district, and they bet a whopping $164,000 on him. _They lost._
**That’s just one piece of the corporate machine Demi is running against.**
And it’s the playbook that these dark money groups run every single cycle. They find spineless candidates who will do their bidding, pour millions into their campaigns, and try to drown out the voices of progressive fighters who actually care about working people.
But just like every other Leaders We Deserve-endorsed candidate, Demi has refused to take a single dollar from corporate PACs. Her entire campaign is funded by grassroots supporters like you, who know exactly what she’s fighting for. Because of your support, Leaders We Deserve was able to invest over $110,000 to help Demi stay competitive.
Part of our investment came early, when we conducted a poll for her race. Most state legislative candidates, especially young candidates, can’t afford to spend campaign money on polling — that’s where we come in. We used the findings from that poll to help Demi’s team map their campaign strategy and uncover a path to victory — despite being up against over a million dollars in outside spending by DraftKings and others. Demi used her resources wisely, outsmarting her corporate backed opponents by making them fight each other instead of attacking her, while she was able to successfully win over 85% of the undecided voters we’d helped identify in our original poll.
**And since it’s a strong blue seat, come November the Illinois State House will have a National Guardswoman who fought fascism firsthand at the Capitol following January 6 instead of a gambling industry lobbyist who campaigned for the favor of corporations, not his constituents.**
Demi’s primary win last month is proof that people power can beat dark money any day. But it takes resources and a movement willing to go toe to toe with corporations that think they can buy our democracy. That’s exactly what Leaders We Deserve was built for.

Thank you,
David Hogg

**On one side:** Voters saw Doris Matsui - an incumbent of 20 years, backed by corporate PACs, who defended the same status quo positions she's held for decades as conditions in our region got worse.

Doris takes money from companies that profit off ICE detention.

She takes AIPAC money and has voted to keep weapons flowing, even in the face of genocide in Gaza.

**On the other:** Me — the daughter of Hmong refugees, raised in South Sacramento. I don’t take any money from corporate PACs or AIPAC. As someone still paying off my student loans, I understand what working families are up against.

I was clear on that stage:

**We need Medicare for All to ensure affordable high quality healthcare is a human right for everyone.**

**We need to abolish ICE, not continue funding a system that tears families apart.**

**We need to spend our money on healthcare and housing at home, not endless wars.**

**We need leadership that answers to people — not corporate PACs.**

And I said something I want to repeat here:

When your campaign is funded by corporate PACs, there’s a debt that comes with it. And that shapes what you fight for — and how hard you’re willing to fight. So with that in mind, I need to ask:

Are you doing fine? Mike Rogers thinks so.
# [](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/685?refcode=&t=1&akid=4415%2E898137%2EVksHfa)
I have an update on a new ad being run by a super PAC backing our MAGA opponent, Mike Rogers.
Americans for Prosperity Action — one of the PACs in the Koch dark money web — just kicked off a $500,000 ad buy to tout Mike Rogers as someone who cares about working families. It’s only April, and they’ll have already spent 1.5 million to prop up Mike Rogers.
Yes, this is the same Mike Rogers who said **“people will be fine”** when he was asked about skyrocketing gas prices.
Hey Mike — people are not fine right now. Go outside your high-dollar donor meetings and talk to real people in Michigan, feeling the squeeze at the gas station or grocery store.
Every day, I talk to Michiganders who feel like they’re watching both parties fighting it out without any connection to what they’re feeling back home.
_In this moment, we need to know how to fight, how to win, and how to actually deliver for people who are struggling._
That starts with fighting against all that right-wing and PAC money that’s flowing into Michigan — millions and millions of dollars. I am taking $0 from corporate PACs in this campaign, because it matters. It matters that I am putting you and your family's interests first.
That’s why we’re asking for your support. [**Michiganders deserve a Senator who will put your interests first — and we can’t count on Mike Rogers to do that. Hey Peter, it’s Jon Ossoff. Before you close this email, I need you to hear this:
Senate Republicans’ leading Super PAC just announced their $342 million plan to defend their Senate majority — and that plan includes spending $44 million against me here in Georgia. _Their largest-ever Georgia investment outside a runoff._
_Not good._
I wasn’t exaggerating when I said this Senate race will be the most competitive and most expensive in the nation.
Peter, I need you with me. The stakes couldn’t be higher. Will you donate $5 to my reelection campaign to help respond to these attacks and win here in Georgia?

Georgia is the tipping point state in the midterms. If Senate Republicans can elect a Trump loyalist in Georgia, they don’t just expand their majority in the Senate — they lock it in for the long-run.
With that power, Trump’s last constraints in the Senate vanish. What’s left is total submission. No oversight. No brakes on extremist nominees. No guardrails when he comes for the rule of law.
That’s what’s at stake in Georgia.
That’s why they’re pouring $44 million into this race. It’s why Republicans will likely spend hundreds of millions more before Election Day.

subject: When Charlie said “35,000,” I laughed...

| | | [](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=26305bdcc5c04293a83451ff6ca47804&_e=TJO-JnwWPfDpmdIRQeUcRCiuItg5bk8ywHvu-3eSjkiFcnS_MEMvj7BUkC1Hz8yMltweKTkVMamLS_Ww2xyCWbQNWvVHWrVdADTzTXntt-2DUIGfF3pRkuYNEneulzxlzWZPgwP136WPog0ocxDJu9-G7NlFsOgkcXN8lNT9UY23Z8GcFQCNn2DKl5rHugXtDwmpQLez-yy1WXEpWynB0fujQrRZDjIL4GjhKVVv_VvRAtEnKwm3r3VPqX6-FrSA-OGSDLvDzZNdM6hS93G3wBLJ2ePynHntmgirtxNyfoXVPsRwrLrLgBVUsIghHnXJmTu1e1ngklid5n9VugsVrJGFRpYN7PhlqBqBH9-fiK9bIwLwHgMOPtnQ90aLuJAjZdYNxc6_T_YswpMNdmiX_6aPE_Q__pvx-gzVae9KiTxG2tDmJpTPVHCv5NLeNmw0QYMiz5zg4aQL2j2yoy3EglN-7jxZYP4PRCvmW6cWBQUx97KFpljAFJsxxkFiW0EBdvqJyBi9ESmHu-ckLVI9jmhUyTy5iFfLTQM8_wrkG-q0GUjE6Pr5KXQQql6TuJnKCaAMEX-gkOqQrIiwbGGku7R5OMv3blfFO6EmQLHQ4p39F_Ga_LtiVWMn8K4Dja-P51EExg6JjdfQhdVxlyhbXTQRm3jr9E9kSp-QTzOqLAxgImslBIzJvIn5QhA7GfZcoBr0RFGzekRaht6HuvKcBA%3D%3D)
---
| | Patriot,
---
I'm going to be blunt with you.

We are closer to losing this country than most people are willing to admit.

Not someday. Not "if things keep going this way."

Right now.

And the scariest part?

It's not happening in Washington. It's happening in classrooms.

High schools. Colleges.

Places where the next generation is being shaped -- or more accurately... reshaped.

If you've ever looked at what's coming out of our schools and thought: _" What happened to this country?" _

You're not wrong. You're seeing it clearly.

Because while most people are arguing online... while they're hoping things will turn around... while they're waiting for the next election to fix everything...

The other side is doing something far more dangerous.

They're raising the next generation.

Earlier. Faster. And with zero resistance in most places.

That's how countries are lost.

Slowly. Then all at once.

But here's the thing that should give a patriot like you hope...

There is one place where that trend is actually being challenged.

_And it shouldn 't even exist. _

**Just one year ago, Turning Point USA 's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.**
That alone felt like a miracle.

Because starting even ONE chapter today takes courage most adults don't have.

Conservative students get mocked. Targeted. Threatened. Shut down.

And yet...

_They stepped up anyway. _

About that time, Charlie called me.

He didn't sound optimistic... He sounded urgent.

"Andrew, we've got to move faster."

I told him we were. He stopped me.

"No. You're not thinking what I'm thinking. I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I actually laughed.

"Charlie... there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said. "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

And without hesitation: "Good. Let's do 27,000."

I remember sitting there thinking to myself... we're barely in 1,200 schools.

We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the infrastructure. We didn't even have the roadmap yet.

But Charlie wasn't fazed.

_" We'll figure it out." _

That was him.

He didn't wait for perfect conditions.

Because he knew something most people don't want to face: If we wait... _we lose everything. _

And now?

Less than a year later...

---
**We 're in 3,300 schools. **

**Thirteen percent of all high schools in America. **

**Eight states are now backing this effort to put a Club America chapter in every high school statewide. **

_That shouldn 't be possible. _

Not in this environment. Not with the level of hostility these students face every single day.

And yet... it's still happening.

_But Patriot, here 's the part you need to understand: _

This is not a victory. It's a foothold.

_Because in the other 87% of schools? _

There is no resistance. None.

Just one-sided propaganda from the Left.

One-sided pressure on kids who are too young to even realize what's happening to them.

That's the reality.

The question isn't whether we're fighting. We are.

The question is whether it's enough.

Because right now, the students stepping up through Club America...

They're not the majority. _They 're the exception. _

They're the ones willing to take the heat.

The ones willing to stand alone.

The ones willing to risk being targeted just to say: _" I love this country." _
---

And every time one of those students raises their hand...

We have a choice.

Back them. _Or leave them on their own. _

**Because when a student starts a chapter, we send them an activism kit -- with American flags. Pocket Constitutions. Leadership tools. **

Everything they need to actually stand their ground.

Not symbolically. For real.

They've already made the decision to lead.

All they're waiting on... is you and me.

**Each activism kit costs $25. That 's it. **

$25 to make sure one student doesn't have to stand alone against the Left in a hostile school.

$25 to put real tools in their hands.

$25 to push back -- even if it's one campus at a time.

**[And Patriot, I’m asking you to send backup to these brave students on the frontlines with your gift to Turning Point USA today.](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=26305bdcc5c04293a83451ff6ca47804&_e=TJO-JnwWPfDpmdIRQeUcRCiuItg5bk8ywHvu-3eSjkiFcnS_MEMvj7BUkC1Hz8yMltweKTkVMamLS_Ww2xyCWbQNWvVHWrVdADTzTXntt-2DUIGfF3pRkuYNEneulzxlzWZPgwP136WPog0ocxDJu9-G7NlFsOgkcXN8lNT9UY23Z8GcFQCNn2DKl5rHugXtDwmpQLez-yy1WXEpWynB0fujQrRZDjIL4GjhKVVv_VvRAtEnKwm3r3VPqX6-FrSAmOCRm74FGxDAN66xAh4vaEbE31W_7x5_mgxdzRugjXM_9PFo13Gj7tXR3in8aZFoE2nYxBtRZ94dRaR1KgDrdVo3KNZQnbUP8EM1DZrrzPLLY24VyPMMqfwFwk_gpwEugX5DndaIO50iPyMdQpp1zIWALCooeUewSe36_JifWCuotskMaOHYM4g8TCuG_lv_BvPydeUo4JLQw9u1_6ioNriyf6p42T6qibKANy9P8XP8dhhtEagRwDdPuOcN4YMlNH9ZgIj2hIxqxw5ptWathxrtN3Pt3-wGTxY0QAVFgHA46i5f__Tw5UjYJ3ZfxZ2hADMPt0cwqwBFOtDQur0XnxPkpkxB117SLublZdzJOtPUz5JSg3DYwRiKcQzkwNt3qLB1JrqNxzYry9PqV0GKMrSsp5tgrWog8cY2Bf8W04C2ivg9Or80d6LnfL207IPwls4YLcWovRfGuh_zReiADw%3D%3D)**
