| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

name: Mandela Barnes
subject: Let’s be honest
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mandela for Wisconsin
body:
Running a campaign the right way
| Thank you for opening this email, friend. **Let’s be honest for a moment: the campaign finance system is broken.** Right now, MAGA billionaires are abusing the breaks in that system to flood our state with negative ads attacking me. They’re trying to bury our campaign early. Asking for money doesn’t come naturally to me. But it’s something that we have to do if we’re going to have a chance of fighting back. This is unacceptable.

I just learned that users on prediction markets were allowed to bet on when missing American pilots in Iran would be rescued. While it’s widely known that trading activity tied to events in Iran has surged, this crosses a serious line.

It’s wrong – and the lack of safeguards raises real concerns about the potential for insider trading by individuals with access to classified information.

**That’s why I introduced bipartisan legislation, the PREDICT Act, to ban government officials – including members of Congress and the Trump Administration – from betting on political events on prediction market platforms.**

It’s clear to see why many Americans deeply distrust our leaders in Washington. If passed, this legislation will prevent corruption and restore confidence in our institutions.

clean_body: | = This is unacceptable. I just learned that users on prediction markets were allowed to bet on when missing American pilots in Iran would be rescued. While it’s widely known that trading activity tied to events in Iran has surged, this crosses a serious line. It’s wrong – and the lack of safeguards raises real concerns about the potential for insider trading by individuals with access to classified information. That’s why I introduced bipartisan legislation, the PREDICT Act, to ban government officials – including members of Congress and the Trump Administration – from betting on political events on prediction market platforms. It’s clear to see why many Americans deeply distrust our leaders in Washington. If passed, this legislation will prevent corruption and restore confidence in our institutions. | Thank you, Nikki | = = = Nikki is a champion for working families – from leading the fight to pass a $15 minimum wage in Illinois, to bringing manufacturing back to America. name: Christopher Ahuja for Congress
subject: Trump said “Destroy a civilization.” Read that again.
body:
Chaos is not a strategy

| | | | | [|
---](https://chrisahuja.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=67424df89870d1cac00e55f46&id=0da549adf1&e=53c7d12fc7)
| | | | | | Dear Peter,
I can’t shake something I read, and I don’t think we should.**Donald Trump threatened that “a whole civilization will die” if Iran didn’t do what he wanted.** Not a military target. A civilization.That is not strength. That is a tantrum.It is what happens when someone who has never been told no is suddenly holding global power and treating diplomacy like a reality show. Threaten first. Escalate. Then quietly fold.Because that’s exactly what happened.After threatening mass destruction, Trump turned around and accepted Iran’s framework for negotiations. The same demands he was ready to destroy them over became the starting point for a deal.So what are we left with?A president who throws around threats of mass death, then caves when it counts. That volatility is dangerous—for our troops, for civilians, and for our credibility on the world stage.And while this plays out, too many in Congress stay silent and keep writing blank checks.**That includes my opponent, Brad Sherman, who has backed unconditional funding for Israel’s military actions no matter how escalatory they become.** That is not leadership. That is complicity.This is how the cycle continues. Escalation abroad. Silence at home. No accountability anywhere.**I’m running for Congress because this cannot be normal.** We need leaders who speak up before things spiral—not after.If you’re as fed up with this as I am, help us build something better.[**Chip in today to support real accountability and steady leadership.**](https://chrisahuja.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=67424df89870d1cac00e55f46&id=caa08e3c2e&e=53c7d12fc7)

Friend, I represent Detroit, a majority-Black city that’s been named the “top asthma capital” of the country—mainly because of air pollution. Black Americans are 30% more likely to have asthma than white Americans. In Detroit, Black residents are nearly four times more likely to be hospitalized due to asthma than white residents. This is environmental racism in action, tied to anti-Black housing and zoning policies. Through years of organizing with the environmental justice community in Detroit, I’ve learned that our government has sacrificed our families’ health and lives so corporate polluters can profit. I’ve been fighting for our right to clean air and water my whole career, and I’ll keep fighting for environmental justice and bold climate action. **Last week, I officially launched the People’s Environmental Justice Caucus in Congress** , alongside Congresswomen Summer Lee and Adelita Grijalva as well as frontline community leaders from across the country. As Trump rolls back environmental protections and Congressional Republicans cut essential funding for programs to get lead out of drinking water, this caucus is more important than ever. We urgently need more members of Congress taking action for environmental justice. [**Can you sign on to become a grassroots member of the newly launched People’s Environmental Justice Caucus—and urge your U.S. Representative to join?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38S9YX4W2uQFg_NbnXsVggljlmZhSBiT5GMGIL4JNMrFGn9yf7YfIrHaAYQ7_a7tUsd9-L9Ur9Dt9whQ8uh7_0CynCUNka6Db5mSlpIJt2VuXxI2BOr8tia7PmjhZGyL5o5CwftgQYB_R5dVQ9i9BkQZhskU7kE9UXVlrxmvn4bN9S-yjneUhyTRKBdLzLYqQRrQMoCqPplv6OJZEjEdAZDI-T35OiyhaK5GC3FQiOopTeYKFJTUqx5cbthZG0c5ArpjuTHyCiCwStGoUE9IhcFUlHcVOkR8t1VZt0x8a28deDycvSxEFX8kzLa_inmr4NmySRxBHs-SbjwPJDkA7-UmQCbCF1dnr2B8rI2uZzmwep4q57_EC07gezPOuik__Z61VVMhpXThRvvLPtNgRxqMgPUS8oLZlp5o8NZ33kEp04aLOfxULZXE2udH1Yqi0nsczywCYldsvl8-27q6vpQ/4pm/wiCnOb09QDeaoKfje9rtIA/h1/h001.KPO2v9Ua8aiBpIvZg-T9ioAnCTrkJ-5a_HjDAyercQc) | [SIGN ON](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38S9YX4W2uQFg_NbnXsVggljlmZhSBiT5GMGIL4JNMrFGn9yf7YfIrHaAYQ7_a7tUsd9-L9Ur9Dt9whQ8uh7_0CynCUNka6Db5mSlpIJt2VuXxI2BOr8tia7PmjhZGyL5o5CwftgQYB_R5dVQ9i9BkQ7ywUMWspXQP8H4merLye0hhe-NDTTuSXUrpUc64fSBeF6r7QiaR5SOJfdJ4dvQV3va2YhZTs9ZByvwV66junJcCnJCF6oeaOtkQMrxF0SS_srhcPaSm945SAfnKVdGKX_bLUOMyaKZT-qn7OuM2sa9-xyq_5KJneByFpPIvESuB6s30bkH4dT05FoGiKj8AhfjAmUVsLCO9_FG13DzYaaQMN0u1RmkxvAy6NR9qs-4UgpLb-bM7bt11BZRuWpoM0cV50PzwNC2v3uZJplLU0R7SR82dLW2P8Bq76Nj1A7bgrf3iD3rq5qTlbtTjs7D3X/4pm/wiCnOb09QDeaoKfje9rtIA/h2/h001.ShlAZ0g__uoZ0cQ02CyC8ApQZgYQGxZ3bkeoi7vs9u4)

I’ve taken on billionaire polluters before, including pushing the Koch brothers to fully clean up and remove toxic waste from Detroit’s riverfront. Now, I'm fighting back as Trump and his administration collaborate with corporations to undo our progress and pollute our communities.
Our fight for environmental justice includes protecting public health, ending racist policies, fighting discrimination, stopping new fossil fuel extraction, supporting renewable energy, addressing climate change’s impacts and the extreme weather it fuels, and more.
I’ve helped create a fund totaling $1.1 billion to help families access clean water, passed historic amendments that would provide $23 billion to fully replace dangerous lead pipes, and successfully worked with federal agencies to protect drinking water and reduce exposure to toxic chemicals.
And I’ll continue leading policies to ensure everyone can access clean water and utilities, strengthen our civil rights and anti-discrimination laws, end poverty and environmental racism, take on the fossil fuel industry, and expand affordable housing and keep people in their homes—including my legislation requiring FEMA to cover basement flood damage and life-saving mold and mildew remediation.
**The People’s Environmental Justice Caucus will serve as a platform for members of Congress to collaborate with community leaders, advocates, and policy experts to advance environmental justice legislation—and ensure that federal policies reflect the needs and priorities of the communities most impacted by environmental harm.**
Supporting the launch of our new caucus, the Climate Justice Alliance coalition noted: _“This is a historic step towards building the just climate future our communities deserve.”_
Dalal Aboulhosn of the Center for Earth, Energy & Democracy said: _“The formation of the House Environmental Justice Caucus is a critical step toward bringing frontline communities into policymaking and ensuring that public health is no longer secondary to corporate profits.”_
[**Will you take a stand for people over profits? Please add your name to support the new People’s Environmental Justice Caucus.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38S9YX4W2uQFg_NbnXsVggljlmZhSBiT5GMGIL4JNMrFGn9yf7YfIrHaAYQ7_a7tUsd9-L9Ur9Dt9whQ8uh7_0CynCUNka6Db5mSlpIJt2VuXxI2BOr8tia7PmjhZGyL5o5CwftgQYB_R5dVQ9i9BkQs9lEvcxuzcLSDBCAq9zhPT5DfAFPaRH7r6_8pAWXOV7BUIiSb3W-h9cDfnqPP7JTISAcKNALL0epQ0VOmUlDPSeWVt68VOHQkMLecmL-y4FuU79DsKYFQm_sDr8pLMssS-kVJECZ-c3fy_9VuxmWHWXugsdrrK7hjKghOHFCGlOA-MMohPAy1jIEYjW15-XUXSTk-BC6_GgP6DM18biCwmVGUdgtPX5e4ffiJfZWHzn45msgUl2yTgNCxhO2UoYB4DOmuj0FkPeTnOYBvCcX3xf1gdokEUWqEnI6Bk6xNHFV56a2r8Ys9mdeob-rdKZx/4pm/wiCnOb09QDeaoKfje9rtIA/h3/h001.t0nM_URIKtjrmIJ5SaKRSBjkEz494XLeEPB8d18ZxC0)

Thank you for being part of the fight for environmental and climate justice. Together we’ll keep fighting to change our government’s priorities and put people over corporate profits.
This is connected to our work to rein in military spending and stop federal lawmakers from profiting off war: The U.S. military is the biggest user of fossil fuels in the world, and the largest institutional emitter of greenhouse gases.
In the past month, the U.S. and Israeli governments’ carpet bombing of Iran and Lebanon has released millions of tons of climate-change-causing emissions—making the world less safe for all of us while poisoning lands, waters, and people for years to come.
We’re all connected, as are our movements for liberation. Although we’re up against powerful industries and government leaders, change always happens because the people demand it. Together we are powerful.

clean_body: “This is a historic step towards building the just climate future our communities deserve.” | | | Friend, I represent Detroit, a majority-Black city that’s been named the “top asthma capital” of the country—mainly because of air pollution. Black Americans are 30% more likely to have asthma than white Americans. In Detroit, Black residents are nearly four times more likely to be hospitalized due to asthma than white residents. This is environmental racism in action, tied to anti-Black housing and zoning policies. Through years of organizing with the environmental justice community in Detroit, I’ve learned that our government has sacrificed our families’ health and lives so corporate polluters can profit. I’ve been fighting for our right to clean air and water my whole career, and I’ll keep fighting for environmental justice and bold climate action. Last week, I officially launched the People’s Environmental Justice Caucus in Congress , alongside Congresswomen Summer Lee and Adelita Grijalva as well as frontline community leaders from across the country. As Trump rolls back environmental protections and Congressional Republicans cut essential funding for programs to get lead out of drinking water, this caucus is more important than ever. We urgently need more members of Congress taking action for environmental justice. | I’ve taken on billionaire polluters before, including pushing the Koch brothers to fully clean up and remove toxic waste from Detroit’s riverfront. Now, I'm fighting back as Trump and his administration collaborate with corporations to undo our progress and pollute our communities. Our fight for environmental justice includes protecting public health, ending racist policies, fighting discrimination, stopping new fossil fuel extraction, supporting renewable energy, addressing climate change’s impacts and the extreme weather it fuels, and more. I’ve helped create a fund totaling $1.1 billion to help families access clean water, passed historic amendments that would provide $23 billion to fully replace dangerous lead pipes, and successfully worked with federal agencies to protect drinking water and reduce exposure to toxic chemicals. And I’ll continue leading policies to ensure everyone can access clean water and utilities, strengthen our civil rights and anti-discrimination laws, end poverty and environmental racism, take on the fossil fuel industry, and expand affordable housing and keep people in their homes—including my legislation requiring FEMA to cover basement flood damage and life-saving mold and mildew remediation. The People’s Environmental Justice Caucus will serve as a platform for members of Congress to collaborate with community leaders, advocates, and policy experts to advance environmental justice legislation—and ensure that federal policies reflect the needs and priorities of the communities most impacted by environmental harm. Supporting the launch of our new caucus, the Climate Justice Alliance coalition noted: “This is a historic step towards building the just climate future our communities deserve.” Dalal Aboulhosn of the Center for Earth, Energy & Democracy said: “The formation of the House Environmental Justice Caucus is a critical step toward bringing frontline communities into policymaking and ensuring that public health is no longer secondary to corporate profits.” Thank you for being part of the fight for environmental and climate justice. Together we’ll keep fighting to change our government’s priorities and put people over corporate profits. This is connected to our work to rein in military spending and stop federal lawmakers from profiting off war: The U.S. military is the biggest user of fossil fuels in the world, and the largest institutional emitter of greenhouse gases. In the past month, the U.S. and Israeli governments’ carpet bombing of Iran and Lebanon has released millions of tons of climate-change-causing emissions—making the world less safe for all of us while poisoning lands, waters, and people for years to come. We’re all connected, as are our movements for liberation. Although we’re up against powerful industries and government leaders, change always happens because the people demand it. Together we are powerful. Onward toward a better future for all, Rashida Rashida Tlaib for Congress PO Box 32777 Detroit, MI 48232 | Paid for by Rashida Tlaib for Congress | | Sent via . This is the Freedom Caucus's number one priority , championed by HFC Policy Chair Chip Roy and backed by every single member of the House Freedom Caucus. Now I'm asking you to match that commitment. # JD Vance launches task force to slash $6 Billion in GOVERNMENT fraud
Vice President JD Vance announced a new task force Tuesday targeting rampant fraud and waste in federal contracting, with initial **[focus on the General Services Administration where a top Biden holdover](https://substack.com/redirect/e6a71af1-afc4-4b23-8036-eb1464a7b5b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** official oversaw massive taxpayer losses.

---|---|---
* **Massive Fraud Exposed:** The GSA under Edward Forst, a Biden-appointed commissioner, wasted over $6 billion on fraudulent and unnecessary government contracts according to internal reviews and whistleblower reports.
* **Vance 's Direct Action:** Vance ordered the immediate creation of a dedicated task force to eliminate fraud across federal agencies, vowing to root out waste and protect American taxpayers from continued abuse.
* **Biden Holdover Criticism:** Edward Forst remained in his senior GSA role despite the scale of documented mismanagement and losses, prompting the new administration to accelerate accountability measures.
* **Taxpayer Protection Focus:** The initiative aims to recover funds and reform contracting processes that allowed billions in improper payments and questionable expenditures during the prior administration.

* **Ceasefire Impact:** The agreement is credited with immediately calming energy markets that had seen historic volatility and price spikes in recent days.
* **Broader Economic Relief:** Analysts noted the positive ripple effects across equities as reduced geopolitical risk boosted broader market sentiment.

# **Man accused of killing Ukrainian refugee Iryna Zarutska deemed mentally incapable of proceeding to trial**
DeCarlos Brown Jr., accused of fatally stabbing 23-year-old Ukrainian refugee Iryna Zarutska on a Charlotte LYNX Blue Line train on August 22, 2025, **[was found"incapable to proceed" to trial](https://substack.com/redirect/879b1edb-9daf-4046-bda4-04fe62cf1742?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after a Central Regional Hospital evaluation, according to court documents.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/879b1edb-9daf-4046-bda4-04fe62cf1742?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **What this means:** Under North Carolina law, defendants deemed incapable cannot be tried or punished by the state.
* **What 's next:** Brown's public defender asked to delay his Rule 24 hearing to determine if state prosecutors will seek the death penalty, while he also faces a federal charge for committing an act of violence resulting in death on a mass transportation system.
* **The case sparked national outrage** over blue city soft-on-crime policies and Brown's lengthy criminal history including 14 previous arrests for armed robbery and assault with a deadly weapon, with him serving five years for armed robbery but avoiding jail time in several other cases. Two months after the killing, Democratic Gov. Josh Stein signed "Iryna's Law," legislation improving the state's criminal justice system by eliminating certain cash-free bail forms and imposing stricter pretrial release requirements for violent offenses.

Trump's Iran "deal" is already falling apart -- and the consequences could be nuclear. On today's _**AMPED UP**_ , [Cliff Schecter](https://open.substack.com/users/31941177-cliff-schecter?utm_source=mentions) and [David Shuster](https://open.substack.com/users/16891317-david-shuster?utm_source=mentions) break down how Trump's threats of annihilation against Iran have backfired spectacularly: Iran is now charging a $2 billion toll on ships passing through the Strait of Hormuz, effectively boosting its own economy by 15% while American consumers foot the bill. Then Dr. Rebecca Lubot, author of _Keeping a Finger on the Button: Presidential Continuity in the Nuclear Age_ , joins to explain why Trump's nuclear brinkmanship has crossed a threshold no modern president--not even Putin--has crossed, and why China, Russia, and France are all changing their nuclear doctrines in response.
In the second half, former MAGA activist Rich Logis tells his powerful story of going from writing for Fox News and The Federalist to founding Leaving MAGA, a nonprofit helping people escape the movement. A Trump campaign volunteer who once called Democrats "worse than Nazis," Rich describes how diversifying his news sources brick by brick dismantled his worldview--and why the Uvalde shooting was his final breaking point. His message to those still in MAGA: you're not alone, and there's a way out. This is essential viewing for anyone trying to understand how people get pulled into extremism and how they find their way back.

name: Team Jayapal
subject: It’s time to chart a new course for the United States and Cuba
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Last week, Pramila visited Cuba as part of an official congressional delegation.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260408-6108-footer&t=1&akid=6108%2E420207%2EuNfyTw)
Peter,
Last week, Pramila went to Cuba and saw the human cost of Donald Trump’s energy blockade up close.
She saw patients in hospitals — from premature babies to cancer patients — who were at risk because of a lack of electricity and medications. Children who couldn’t attend school without fuel. And a frightening drop in the supply of drinkable water and food all over the island.
And this is happening even though the Cuban government has taken steps to ease tensions and open the door to cooperation — pardoning more than 2,000 prisoners, allowing an FBI team to help investigate the fatal shooting of five men on a U.S.-flagged boat, and opening its economy to investment from Cuban Americans abroad.
But so far, Trump hasn’t budged on his blockade.
He’s threatened to tariff any country that helps provide oil to Cuba — only making an exception for Russia.
**The failed embargo policy that has been in place for decades is a Cold War remnant that no longer serves the American people or the Cuban people.**
It’s time to chart a new course.
The United States and Cuba need to enter real negotiations that help the people of both our countries.
[**If you agree, add your name to our petition demanding the Trump administration _not_ go to war with Cuba, and pursue a new strategy that will provide for the dignity and freedom of the Cuban people instead.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/sign/em20260408-cuba/?source=em20260408-6108&t=2&akid=6108%2E420207%2EuNfyTw)

| | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus.

He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness.

And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible.

I saw it up close -- _Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. _

But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything.

_**He started observing the Sabbath. **_

Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance.

_But as an act of obedience. _

As a way of saying, **_" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." _**

Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped.

He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield.

No email. No media. No work.

He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children.

It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much.

But over time, it changed him.

And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned...

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Filing your taxes is more difficult and more expensive in 2026 because of Trump. Here’s how:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2848%2E4032634%2EvGSJbN)
---
In case you needed the reminder: Tax Day is one week from today. And unfortunately, filing your taxes is more difficult and more expensive in 2026 because of Donald Trump’s actions. Here’s how:
1. **Trump and DOGE slashed one-forth of IRS staff last year.** These were the people responsible for processing your returns as fast as possible and helping taxpayers with questions.
2. **Trump keeps firing IRS leadership.** We’re on IRS Commissioner #6 since he took office. This only creates more and more chaos internally.
3. **Trump canceled Direct File.** This was the program we launched that let you file your taxes directly with the government for FREE (meaning no more $240 TurboTax charges and numerous hours wasted simply for sending your taxes in)._Perhaps Intuit — TurboTax’s parent company — and their generous $1 million donation to Trump had something to do with his decision?_
4. **Republicans in Congress have ripped away billions of dollars in funding that the IRS used to go after wealthy and corporate tax cheats.** This enforcement raised the government about $26 per every $1 spent auditing the top 0.1 percent. With no enforcement, those tax dollars remain in wealthy tax cheats’ pockets instead of being invested in our communities.

We’re fighting back. I just introduced legislation to get Congress to reverse Trump’s decision to cancel Direct File. This would save families up to **$23 billion** annually. And I just introduced my plan for a two-cent wealth tax on billionaires to finally get the ultra-wealthy to pay their fair share in taxes AND rebuild and strengthen the IRS. **Look, it’s clear why Trump is attacking programs like Direct File and trying to weaken the IRS: greed and corruption. He’s catering to the billionaire and corporate class at the cost of everyday Americans.** [**Not on my watch. If you oppose the Trump administration’s attacks on the Direct File program and the IRS, add your name to say you’re with me in this fight.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-trump-irs/?source=EW_EMZ30Q_TAX_ENG_20260408_F&t=8&akid=2848%2E4032634%2EvGSJbN) | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-trump-irs/?source=EW_EMZ30Q_TAX_ENG_20260408_F&t=9&akid=2848%2E4032634%2EvGSJbN)
---
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

Everything is on the line, and that's not an exaggeration. If we want to revive this nation, we start at the state level: with unapologetic, America First governors who stare down the administrative state and actually deliver results.
The Democrat Machine has already thrown its weight behind Amy Acton - they'll spend whatever it takes to flip Ohio.
And if she wins, we know exactly what's coming:
Dr. Amy Acton - Ohio's Chief Lockdown Officer - ordered businesses to close, banned in-person worship, and shut down our schools during COVID-19, causing lasting harm to kids, families, and communities.
She was wrong then. She's wrong now. But she still defends every decision.

* * *
Iran Ceasefire, Barely

Trump announced a two-week ceasefire with Iran Tuesday night, less than two hours before his deadline for Tehran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz or face devastating attacks—a last-minute deal brokered with Pakistan's help that landed as [ceasefire terms remained disputed](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLFyhSAURL9GOxxABSwo0ti9tCmdG7jqnSg4wNMkX58xRT4g3Ta7O-e8PaYH0EZheYUdrTtp8tFPlCA4hIwzJVwhLPn9C8qacJJcKsY7xs0UtknU3jqvWlmjFVr3auBCy3q1vRC-n8F3SmsOvZmNaYfOC2NQSeN0TfZe4h03shVK8GZwMGgjpRkQFcx91fHn4aFgblwMGdMJhU6kEOKdYmhc3OvNrqUcuWpfKjlWcryuq5njZ8Drru2VHI-4USGXKzmW9NwPBktCzEyyC_GD_VGym5nFA0NmuSSgwtaY9ud3naw_Lto2ykpXHV92oO33vPzD12nlTwAAAP__EXh8NQ). The truce is already wobbling: Iran's Supreme National Security Council called it a [victory over U.S. demands](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL1urTAMgJ8GtqDE_ASGDHdhO3e9I_IN5mApJCgJ0PbpK06rPkA3e_is7_O_x_RAduyff3EjY0-e5jBPHNFbwkQLR1rRP9P_d8xrpAkkdEI2QvaTd5MqZ2PnroaSjNK67QapNJSrUVr2VuFSNy30WsPStAoXtLK2eoZOl2zuS7KRPdSqU7IaLA66B-gHog6Xtmjksc-YKVU2-ETxxMwnsffhnoKvbNhKZ9ac91TUfwoYCxiv66qW8ObpurGtgNHxSeLeCxhzPLZdHEncfeLCKH4iRcoROYs1xO34EJwikhMv-Fvjq1rc2mU0836xc5w6XTTyuSG7l0_-xQtPA58BAAD__zV1gaE), Israel has continued strikes in Lebanon, and confusion remains over exactly when the Strait passage reopens. The White House pushed back hard: press secretary Karoline Leavitt said the ceasefire was "a victory for the United States," and VP Vance warned that America retains [the right to resume strikes](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL1urTAMgJ8GtqDE_ASGDHdhO3e9I_IN5mApJCgJ0PbpK06rPkA3e_is7_O_x_RAduyff3EjY0-e5jBPHNFbwkQLR1rRP9P_d8xrpAkkdEI2QvaTd5MqZ2PnroaSjNK67QapNJSrUVr2VuFSNy30WsPStAoXtLK2eoZOl2zuS7KRPdSqU7IaLA66B-gHog6Xtmjksc-YKVU2-ETxxMwnsffhnoKvbNhKZ9ac91TUfwoYCxiv66qW8ObpurGtgNHxSeLeCxhzPLZdHEncfeLCKH4iRcoROYs1xO34EJwikhMv-Fvjq1rc2mU0836xc5w6XTTyuSG7l0_-xQtPA58BAAD__zV1gaE) if Iran violates terms. ★★★
Democrats Go Nuclear on Trump

More than 85 House Democrats have called for Trump's removal since his Tuesday night threat that "a whole civilization will die tonight," filing [articles of impeachment and 25th Amendment letters](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0LvO3CAUBOCnwR0rjM2toEjj7k-b0joLxwsSFwtYr_L2kfcR0n3SSDPS_PnZfyCmWF6_IaN1V9x99XtsUBxCxyM2DFBe_fkXRmi4c8YlZStlei9pnydvnZcLn9DOSglp2Kz4FOyyGKWdOLxeBZMgFikQ9GGYV1I9gU3R3k1sZZovs5zZwzgwSnOuDaKEQ5CVvU8PA_vD1dKxXTDihbGUequWh6t5SjaMcXay_CJ8I3wbAUNM6c4I30LNWPDTv3x3JHwTejZSGuoxV9dgdDraO5-0Ya4XJMoFhYzFZyyDxnwiuHCb8G1q1p-fmFLsUpGVvTLE79I0_uO4y_J_AQAA__-h7n2F) even after the ceasefire was announced. Rep. John Larson, D-Conn., filed formal impeachment articles Tuesday morning. Multiple members sent letters to VP Vance and the Cabinet invoking the 25th Amendment—a process that requires the Cabinet to act, and Trump's Cabinet has shown no interest in doing so. The White House dismissed the calls as proof Democrats are "deranged, weak, and ineffective." [Some Republicans also raised concerns](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLFuhDAQRL8GOiOzgIHCRRq6S5sSLfYerM7YyPZB8vcR-YR008yM3vt6zA9kx379xJ20OXm2wc4c0RvCRE-OtKFf0_KDeYs0gwQlZCvkMHs316XVxqoGStJ133dqlHUP5aYBuwEkLLUdaTRgTT9A145D16t6wUaVrO8l2coBmlrVshoNjv0AMIxECp9d0cr3YTFTqkzwieKJmU9i78Odgq9M2Eunt5yPVDQfBUwFTNd1Vc_w7em6a3sB0xEcZzapgCnH934kccOJGwaziJizoyTWcIhIx3txbNAnsUTCl4joX6mM2h4XO8dJ9UUr1x3Z_Z3nf_g6NfwGAAD__zs8fJQ) about Trump's Iran rhetoric—but none have backed removal or joined the impeachment effort. ★★★
Day 53: DHS Still Dark

The Department of Homeland Security shutdown hit Day 53 with no resolution in sight. The House passed a 60-day continuing resolution on a party-line vote, but it's dead on arrival in the Senate. Congress is on recess until April 14, and [any emergency vote requires unanimous consent](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLGunTAQRL8GOiN7LxgoXKShe2lTosVewHrGi2xfyP37iHzC60Yjzejo_Pmav9AHH7ffeJCxl58du9knjJYw0-oT7Ri3vHyw7IlmkKCFbIUc5hhmVTtjnX5BTUb1fadHqXqod9PjsgKsbau1VWM3aEvWLkrKYQBS0NXePE-ylQO8lFayGS2O_QAwjEQa165q5ft0WCg3lmOmdGHxF_kY-UkcG8tHHcxeypmr168Kpgqm-76blf9Gup_ZUcF0cvDF21zBlOjkVChlEbnQwvwt7v0jSnofpzjw89QCl0Bi5WRJWI5bopzFgvZb8EVJuD2LvL-L4zvWybjz9iH4rPuqlduBPvynKj8QeRn4FwAA__-HmIZr)—which Democrats have shown no interest in granting. body:
What we learned from the spring election
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260408-2701)
Peter,
Congratulations are in order for Tom Tiffany, who delivered the best quote of the day: "We got our butts kicked...but every election is unique."

Chris Taylor won the Supreme Court race by 20+ points. AP called it in 40 minutes. The court now has a 5-2 progressive majority — the biggest in decades — and Taylor's margin was even bigger than the last three liberal wins, which were all in the 10-point range.
That's four straight Supreme Court wins for progressive candidates in Wisconsin. Since 2017, progressive and Democratic-aligned candidates have won 19 of the last 24 statewide races in Wisconsin. Not close races. Decisive wins.
But it's the map that tells the real story. Taylor won at least 24 counties that Trump carried in 2024 — including Sheboygan (Trump+16), Marathon (Trump+19), and Vilas (Trump+23). She flipped Ozaukee County — one of the three WOW counties — for the first time in over 60 years. She shrank the Waukesha County margin to single digits.

Speaking of Waukesha, on the same night, Alicia Halvensleben won the mayor's race, beating State Rep. Scott Allen, one of the most conservative Republicans in the Legislature. The WOW county wall is crumbling.
CNN called last night [one of the best election nights](https://act.francescahong.com/go/10474?t=1&akid=2701%2E105371%2EHSZ9qK) of the Trump era. Analysts said the swings in Wisconsin and Georgia were more than double the average this year. Meanwhile, seven of our Republican state lawmakers have retired in the last three months — including the leaders of both chambers. When the other side's leaders start heading for the exits, you know something's changed.
So what does all this mean? The stage is set for a progressive blue wave in Wisconsin. We've secured the court. We've undone the gerrymander and made the maps fair. The voters are choosing their elected officials, not the other way around.
The people are coming together to demand better, and we're going to deliver. Because working families deserve a government that works for them and answers to them.
That's why I'm running for governor — to create permanent affordability in Wisconsin. It’s time for universal childcare. Paid leave for all. Cheaper healthcare. Fully funded public schools. A fair tax code.
This is our moment. If we keep this up, we can kickstart a whole new era in Wisconsin. But we can’t do it without you.
[Every dollar you give right now goes directly into reaching more voters, knocking more doors, and making sure we don't waste the best opportunity Wisconsin has had in a generation.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260406.SZru0n&refcode=em20260408-2701&t=2&akid=2701%2E105371%2EHSZ9qK)
Wisconsin is ready. Let's go.
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260406.SZru0n&amount=5&refcode=em20260408-2701&t=21&akid=2701%2E105371%2EHSZ9qK)**
With gratitude!
— Team Hong

| Trump is abusing his power to go to war that no one asked for, voted for, or approved.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=9715%2E5257348%2ECV4vAM)
Donald Trump threatened to destroy an entire civilization. This crosses a line that should have never been approached, Derek.
The President of the United States has threatened to destroy an entire civilization, which would be an unconscionable war crime. Just making the threat is destructive of so much of what this country has stood for since its founding.
While he’s threatening the unthinkable, brazenly boasting that he will commit war crimes by committing genocide, Republican leaders have kept Congress in recess. That is a dangerous abdication of our responsibility.
Donald Trump has led us into an illegal war, without a clear justification, strategy, or a definable endpoint. A two-week ceasefire doesn’t change any of this.
**Congress must finally reclaim its war power from this increasingly dangerous president.**
Before he creates more chaos and destruction. Before more servicemembers get killed.
If Republicans in Congress refuse to help us stop him, they will be complicit in whatever actions Donald Trump takes and whatever lives are lost.
**Congress must act. We must return to session and vote to end this war.**

**This email is a little longer, but it's worth your time.** [**I’m humbly asking you to read it through and consider donating to my campaign for Alabama’s next Governor when you’re finished.**](http://links.tubervilleforalabama.com/u/click?_t=b8b4efbe79f64b579dfa7d8da685a7a9&_m=a1843c3c28ec4880b95a6bbba977aec0&_e=1SDO1QVroZZLZ5bS4SiOMuzy77qqatcS28GHHMiUilAtUcIHU57hI44PFNPfOsZhXaMyucPga6AkmYEZTycjJnC09mbid3zWZA4iIMwcm9uyETnEKPVdAqVn_XPCLEllCpMdodQRXSNaZRYhEvZxXfaA-Y7NKBGnd64YX9vrXujeAg7YKglg_ZJIwJLD33DEq760NP_zyn3Qt5TYIeWGO__ADQ9ccX2N-_YSsn-RlEPxTHHJ80t45xT9oyBwYo9szU0RwlgbVX1UllrOQLIBs6H_ap4yl3OmRk7281H6fLNYNGh3bWnNSveTW6BUxTCNtUaxb602-j4Bav8xr5r7eYSzs3PWYwEcqu3Q4fod4LKu7_4S6R-knXx6TWBCC96iIwIJa-u27BjgazeenbSldtza41nsp2fywvwptseJiqsX6XfBJB3FZY5Ij3u1U8MRkdftVLe_DNKOPSQQAh-zE5hGCBIRAGhooWqrGGY6bYojdVv5wn9yT1hmXVCNtT3nUhkdlDjYk3zVuL74mEDiIKdvtWhaSWWckugZ8h5pywueX-N6mqpQLFCmK7m3ZDQH)

I was born in Camden, Arkansas, as the third of three children to my parents, Olive and Charles Tuberville. They raised me to consistently work hard and stand on principle, which I've brought with me every step of my life.

I met my wife, Suzanne, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans in 1989. We married three years later and have two amazing children, Tucker and Troy. _**They continue to make me proud every single day.**_

[](http://links.tubervilleforalabama.com/u/click?_t=b8b4efbe79f64b579dfa7d8da685a7a9&_m=a1843c3c28ec4880b95a6bbba977aec0&_e=1SDO1QVroZZLZ5bS4SiOMuzy77qqatcS28GHHMiUilAtUcIHU57hI44PFNPfOsZhXaMyucPga6AkmYEZTycjJnC09mbid3zWZA4iIMwcm9uyETnEKPVdAqVn_XPCLEllCpMdodQRXSNaZRYhEvZxXfaA-Y7NKBGnd64YX9vrXujeAg7YKglg_ZJIwJLD33DEtSEOrSsGGAs_RboUhtPU58dVdocqzjUNiBoayheaUIKX5bKsi6dgRqzl7LN_vS7DPGNm0uXBS47l-yVq2T9lNTrxCyEZxXWyIObv4a15qQidED_7GBN7VQGpqtMFaYV-Qx3K463t6NdxQzMYotyqgP5IiYqST9lF6syo7nl3peglnzZlSXc-o7RP3_eMMtu3lbY-IbSJfpcSNczXV7XSLLZws4-1TN1TlqDccQL4oomg6GrpF6a5mms-ugL2CyWS0vgUstEmtyPeS_-Y4ZOI8FzOwGd1vpioY1aKRm3G8cwzFr7SJ1wWXDc4en5Blvt62jbnzoXyrOlrAOZ0S0iS_hT_pVFdtbzR3jQFI9mqUZIfi5aVO56Gu3d3T4mfqJ4a)
After graduating from SAU, I took my first coaching job at Hermitage High School before graduating to the college level as an assistant coach at Arkansas State University.

Just two years later, I started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, where I went on to become their defensive coordinator. By the time I left the U, we had created one of the most storied programs in college football history. We won three AP national championships, and I coached future Hall-of-Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

[](http://links.tubervilleforalabama.com/u/click?_t=b8b4efbe79f64b579dfa7d8da685a7a9&_m=a1843c3c28ec4880b95a6bbba977aec0&_e=1SDO1QVroZZLZ5bS4SiOMuzy77qqatcS28GHHMiUilAtUcIHU57hI44PFNPfOsZhXaMyucPga6AkmYEZTycjJnC09mbid3zWZA4iIMwcm9uyETnEKPVdAqVn_XPCLEllCpMdodQRXSNaZRYhEvZxXfaA-Y7NKBGnd64YX9vrXujeAg7YKglg_ZJIwJLD33DEeWXKqpdKvOoaMlvgP4AuklQGLMUB9wl4SA4V3fFZQw3Q4T_t1sRxtvZrl1QO-ssoyW4zgBESGum_niPvIaexZEP4YmAct9XwRnkUKUogbL4aZpqnNTjjMC8O8qS_7aaEP9zL5g-1VeCy-pVdX-Yf-olPHbteUs6jxXHMWWN9Jrcy7ksVmf5TxMaEHIZBCMXxwLYN-fRaOX_uCOXTFJqyG_lzCp2K1RF4VTeXUkGVF5HLv3ePcTvLHYXgILbRO06k4M7D6rDNxNzJbIfidzLwGce-7eAtt2cLXnxqTm5zR3PT_JJLWv5Ve9YQa_j7vbeMjjCylPZKFB2R3b2ItFGmzCyC46VqyR_cxeT_MHq9tLEgv5kG_maWNx7-L2FIGnxQ)
I spent a short stint as the head coach for Ole Miss before becoming the head coach for the Auburn Tigers in 1998. I solidified my career there, making eight consecutive bowl appearances, winning five SEC Western Division Titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004 when I was named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year, among other awards.

I continued coaching at Texas Tech University and the University of Cincinnati until I retired from coaching in 2016 as one of the top 50 most-winning college football coaches of all time. But I wasn't done winning just yet.

**In 2020, I went from Coach Tuberville to Senator Tuberville. After talking to my fellow Alabamians, I was enlightened by President Trump's concerns about the direction of our country, and I decided to do something about it. I ran for the United States Senate and won.**

**Throughout my time in Washington, D.C., I 've fought nonstop on President Trump's behalf.** Whether it was fighting back against the countless witch-hunts, challenging the Biden-Harris Administration's Radical and harmful policies, or working with President Trump to secure our border, protect women in sports, and make our military prioritize readiness over wokeness, I always worked hard. I stood on principle, just like my folks taught me at a young age.

[](http://links.tubervilleforalabama.com/u/click?_t=b8b4efbe79f64b579dfa7d8da685a7a9&_m=a1843c3c28ec4880b95a6bbba977aec0&_e=1SDO1QVroZZLZ5bS4SiOMuzy77qqatcS28GHHMiUilAtUcIHU57hI44PFNPfOsZhXaMyucPga6AkmYEZTycjJnC09mbid3zWZA4iIMwcm9uyETnEKPVdAqVn_XPCLEllCpMdodQRXSNaZRYhEvZxXfaA-Y7NKBGnd64YX9vrXujeAg7YKglg_ZJIwJLD33DEI9UcJU2h2uJiarG1l9aVcLpmbWtd7UdWSoBu9Ap0LUUa4TT6jM6JHZMEyrZ-9YNyaOCRiuAtyuFche-CQBdPWpSecYgcrbWadO56zH-ukbgdzEKbjCJYpWrah-y5D69HfVMKcDNTWBTizZ3WdWBgcrC8GDDyB2nXEl2lZ9zvtShe2933bpydQT5ZjBtuu72OaUgBYMoCQGqDr8eKy9PjyySkJuhAyp0QvWjrpnq8dRC1OkwkI8R56y8GdJQi0Ig1q5SJcXfcDM5YMfzmI3ZtjslyrOjkPKA-cVaOY2SGih7-64qaLkAxl_0-VlmfVaw7gM_Tq7ExPBSdC784MrbvYoYMyrBT8GDcnu2e6PbfyeT1ylXn-7e3XswbQKIj2zkz)
**Now, I 'm running for Governor in Alabama so I can continue making an impact for my community back home.**

The Radical Left has circled me as one of their top gubernatorial targets to defeat in 2026. They're going to spend MILLIONS of dollars trying to beat me. But if coaching in the SEC has taught me one thing, it's this: there will always be a rival trying to bring you down, but with hard work and a strong team, you can go 13-0.

**I 'm looking to go 2-0 in my lifetime as a political candidate, and I need your help to do so.**

[**Peter, can you chip in just $10 before midnight to give my campaign the resources we need to defeat the Radical Left and protect America First Alabamian values?**](http://links.tubervilleforalabama.com/u/click?_t=b8b4efbe79f64b579dfa7d8da685a7a9&_m=a1843c3c28ec4880b95a6bbba977aec0&_e=1SDO1QVroZZLZ5bS4SiOMuzy77qqatcS28GHHMiUilAtUcIHU57hI44PFNPfOsZhXaMyucPga6AkmYEZTycjJnC09mbid3zWZA4iIMwcm9uyETnEKPVdAqVn_XPCLEllCpMdodQRXSNaZRYhEvZxXfaA-Y7NKBGnd64YX9vrXujeAg7YKglg_ZJIwJLD33DERWK-ZLq9yvkxnWu6XUTZ2rfJ3NPcgcIQP53NjT15Dx1yDHO2gLT6YMddMzALXXazSxUHVwevHSbir-MAZscEyEOyoEnI65pwVSJhYZKMxZ7zlFgnuLWxWQYqpTyH-mnmYMZdiSpXBYWg_RGqx6uU5fJtzssi0TIixwCt-VLs70WDRVDR2CHAhP3WWSWWPpWIuCTHw52mdX-TVwzotHkwm4-mDBKxgwJxO_HK6v0jZbE0uj0XFeWJ9UuvIJVTNUx2_Mp-yHfUssV12_mnfScvAtAz5CpCTt_s2cyz-g27wMJiaUXrJnMz4gZTv1J99G1y0iE0PUYoutveVFGcnMDtsfPmG3iI5ClILZZ1pV-Urc39835gp9d94IX_ZJY-KQia)

[**Thank you for reading this all the way through, and please consider donating any amount to help!**](http://links.tubervilleforalabama.com/u/click?_t=b8b4efbe79f64b579dfa7d8da685a7a9&_m=a1843c3c28ec4880b95a6bbba977aec0&_e=1SDO1QVroZZLZ5bS4SiOMuzy77qqatcS28GHHMiUilAtUcIHU57hI44PFNPfOsZhXaMyucPga6AkmYEZTycjJnC09mbid3zWZA4iIMwcm9uyETnEKPVdAqVn_XPCLEllCpMdodQRXSNaZRYhEvZxXfaA-Y7NKBGnd64YX9vrXujeAg7YKglg_ZJIwJLD33DEj3iOXCLvGRAjq3B2E5PeZlVuv3imIkDxe4nYNEwxXWi1NQTjs4-w0iJ6aOhV3uJ11UmmwlUE-GbUEkerJKiw4hh5uvg2kvMdXxBGakdMvlQq5VgYB7QT_8cU2dSdekZN2njWbWYcbs0dd843Uj3pWA7tHbSwQjdDVKaNrXMeZsbRBo6SBshQviJ3aUtBjKd_07cdtLitKZCHJ9EHLDBx4Sac9G2zt-NVKeGhZmlYXfnu47Cab1bCiDkV1etEuXst6Cp51VY_XDKwlJ4FVW8BjyFRNHBItNjJw4hxSIPBy7HEEQvRCwY_vGquh1dlRSAlWlyxk1E1Iuf_TAw69D_O35H77lKst1xzN3CTb1HKO5jqYxRFLNlBleHwolBd7zFU)

**Why I 'm Running -- And Why This Race Could Decide Everything**
_A Message from Harry Dunn, Candidate for Congress in Maryland 's 5th District_
[JOIN THE FIGHT](https://substack.com/redirect/94ff80ba-4fe5-49da-84c3-02e54a91faf7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/94ff80ba-4fe5-49da-84c3-02e54a91faf7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This race is personal to me.
Not personal in the way politicians usually mean it -- not because I've spent years dreaming about a seat in Congress or because I've been prepped for this moment by party insiders.
**It 's personal because I've seen firsthand what's at stake when democracy is left undefended.**
**I 'm running for Congress because January 6th taught me that democracy doesn't defend itself -- people do. But winning this race won't be easy. It will take real resources, real organizing, and real people willing to stand up. [Before I ask you to be one of those people](https://substack.com/redirect/94ff80ba-4fe5-49da-84c3-02e54a91faf7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), I want to share a little more about where I come from and why this moment brought me here:**
I played college football. I tried to make it in the NFL. That road was hard -- physically, mentally, emotionally -- and it taught me a lot about what it means to get up after you get knocked down. When that door closed, I found my calling in public service. I became a Capitol Police Officer, and I served for over 15 years. I showed up every day to protect the people who make our laws, the building where our democracy lives, and the idea that this country belongs to all of us.
I loved that work. I believed in it.
_And then came January 6th, 2021._
I've been asked hundreds of times to describe what that day was like. The honest answer? It's hard to put into words. What I experienced wasn't just an insurrection. It wasn't just chaos. It was hours submerged in something I can only describe as a wall of hatred -- sweat, screams, blood, broken bones, slurs directed at me and my fellow officers by people who had been told by the President of the United States that we were the enemy.
Through it all, I never stopped fighting. I defended the Capitol the way I had sworn to -- not because it was easy, but because that oath meant something to me.
And when it was over, I thought the hardest part was behind me.
**I was wrong.**
The weight of that day didn't lift when the sun rose on January 7th. If anything, what came after was its own kind of battle... death threats, harassment, a sustained campaign to discredit anyone who called what it was: a violent, coordinated attempt to overturn a free and fair election.
When I was asked to speak in front of the January 6th Committee, I testified because it was my duty -- not just as an officer, but as an American. I stepped forward because someone had to. And I've never looked back.
**That testimony, that choice to speak truth to power, set me on the path to this race. I realized that defending democracy isn 't something you do once, on one terrible day, and then walk away from. It's ongoing. It's relentless. And it needs people who won't flinch.**
So here's where we are:
I'm running for Congress in Maryland's 5th District -- a seat that could genuinely determine the balance of power in the House. This isn't a safe race or a foregone conclusion. This is a competitive primary in a must-win district, and if Democrats don't show up, we hand an opening to the MAGA machine that will gladly take it.
But look, I'm not a millionaire, and I can't afford to self-fund this campaign.
**I 'm a former Capitol Police Officer who relies entirely on grassroots support from people like you. Every dollar my campaign raises comes from someone who made a choice -- a real, conscious choice -- to invest in a different kind of representation.**
My team has set a goal of raising $10,000 this week. It isn't an arbitrary number -- it's what we need to keep our office open and our digital ads live.
#### **[So please, chip in whatever you can today to help power my grassroots campaign to victory. Together, we can flip the House blue and end Donald Trump's grip on our nation:](https://substack.com/redirect/94ff80ba-4fe5-49da-84c3-02e54a91faf7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[JOIN THE FIGHT](https://substack.com/redirect/94ff80ba-4fe5-49da-84c3-02e54a91faf7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

clean_body: This race is deeply personal to me. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more This race is deeply personal to me. | | | Apr 8 | | | | | | | | | | Why I 'm Running -- And Why This Race Could Decide Everything A Message from Harry Dunn, Candidate for Congress in Maryland 's 5th District | | ---|---|--- This race is personal to me. Not personal in the way politicians usually mean it -- not because I've spent years dreaming about a seat in Congress or because I've been prepped for this moment by party insiders. It 's personal because I've seen firsthand what's at stake when democracy is left undefended. I 'm running for Congress because January 6th taught me that democracy doesn't defend itself -- people do. But winning this race won't be easy. It will take real resources, real organizing, and real people willing to stand up. , I want to share a little more about where I come from and why this moment brought me here: I played college football. I tried to make it in the NFL. That road was hard -- physically, mentally, emotionally -- and it taught me a lot about what it means to get up after you get knocked down. When that door closed, I found my calling in public service. I became a Capitol Police Officer, and I served for over 15 years. I showed up every day to protect the people who make our laws, the building where our democracy lives, and the idea that this country belongs to all of us. I loved that work. I believed in it. And then came January 6th, 2021. I've been asked hundreds of times to describe what that day was like. The honest answer? It's hard to put into words. What I experienced wasn't just an insurrection. It wasn't just chaos. It was hours submerged in something I can only describe as a wall of hatred -- sweat, screams, blood, broken bones, slurs directed at me and my fellow officers by people who had been told by the President of the United States that we were the enemy. Through it all, I never stopped fighting. I defended the Capitol the way I had sworn to -- not because it was easy, but because that oath meant something to me. And when it was over, I thought the hardest part was behind me. I was wrong. The weight of that day didn't lift when the sun rose on January 7th. If anything, what came after was its own kind of battle... death threats, harassment, a sustained campaign to discredit anyone who called what it was: a violent, coordinated attempt to overturn a free and fair election. When I was asked to speak in front of the January 6th Committee, I testified because it was my duty -- not just as an officer, but as an American. I stepped forward because someone had to. And I've never looked back. That testimony, that choice to speak truth to power, set me on the path to this race. I realized that defending democracy isn 't something you do once, on one terrible day, and then walk away from. It's ongoing. It's relentless. And it needs people who won't flinch. So here's where we are: I'm running for Congress in Maryland's 5th District -- a seat that could genuinely determine the balance of power in the House. This isn't a safe race or a foregone conclusion. This is a competitive primary in a must-win district, and if Democrats don't show up, we hand an opening to the MAGA machine that will gladly take it. But look, I'm not a millionaire, and I can't afford to self-fund this campaign. I 'm a former Capitol Police Officer who relies entirely on grassroots support from people like you. Every dollar my campaign raises comes from someone who made a choice -- a real, conscious choice -- to invest in a different kind of representation. My team has set a goal of raising $10,000 this week. It isn't an arbitrary number -- it's what we need to keep our office open and our digital ads live. ** Thank you, -- Harry Dunn You're currently a free subscriber to . Back in the mid-1980s, I was a geologist – until I was laid off for 27 months. Then, I took every scrap of savings in my bank account and took a gamble on opening my own business, Wynkoop Brewing Company, in downtown Denver.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129073813/613195535/-1168903340?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_FLHP_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20260408_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY0NjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDI1YmFlMzgtYTUzMy1mMTExLThlZjItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=LTmrVWD1H2pi0jTbqmTy1Kza6D5UShKjzUeieON-L_Q=)
I remember working 80-hour weeks. I remember lying awake at night wondering how we were going to make it. And I remember being so angry that my government wasn't working for me.
So, I ran for Mayor. And once elected, I focused every day on making decisions based on what was best for Denver.
Then, I was elected Governor on the premise of uniting people, finding common ground, hashing things out, and getting things done.
And after we flipped Colorado’s Senate seat in 2020, I got my hands dirty working hard to deliver real change for Coloradans. We invested billions of dollars to confront the climate crisis, lowered prescription drug costs, made investments to rebuild our infrastructure, and brought thousands of good-paying manufacturing jobs back to America.
But I’ve also seen how broken Washington is. I see politicians who only listen to those who cut big campaign checks while ignoring the rest of us. And it’s clear we need more leaders who are willing to cut through the political deadlock and work to move this country forward.
Here's why I'm telling you this: **my story is the reason I remain grounded amid the nonsense and dysfunction that's happening in our government.**
Because with all the chaos in Washington, you need somebody who rolls up their sleeves and fights every day for all of us – not just those they agree with.
Like I said, I never thought I'd find myself in the U.S. Senate, but I’m running for re-election because Coloradans deserve a leader they can trust to do right by them. And I'm just a geologist-turned-brewer who entered public service to do what's right for the people of my state.
That’s why I don't take money from corporate PACs like your typical politician. Instead, I rely on grassroots folks like you. And it’s why I'm depending on your contribution today. Even just $5 here or $10 there goes a long way in a campaign like ours.
**[So I have to ask: will you split a donation of whatever is meaningful to you between Fight Like Hell PAC and my campaign? name: Letlow for Louisiana
subject: LETLOW IN FIRST, CASSIDY IN THIRD IN BACK-TO-BACK INDEPENDENT POLLS
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Julia Letlow for Louisiana
body:
Where the Race Stands

| | |
---
| | | | [|
---](https://julialetlow.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=70758973fc60553eda6683b43&id=7cf6073dc1&e=95355a072c)
| | | | | | **TO:** Interested Parties
**FROM:** Parker Carey, Campaign Manager
**DATE:** April 8, 2026**RE:** LETLOW IN FIRST, CASSIDY IN THIRD IN BACK-TO-BACK INDEPENDENT POLLS
* * *
**WHERE THE RACE STANDS** Two independent surveys conducted within days of each other now show the same clear picture in Louisiana’s Republican Senate primary: Trump-endorsed Julia Letlow is in first place, and Bill Cassidy has collapsed to third.
A survey by [BDPC Strategic Campaign Services](https://julialetlow.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=70758973fc60553eda6683b43&id=702bec2faf&e=95355a072c), conducted March 16-17, found Letlow leading with **29.0%** , followed by John Fleming at **23.5%** and Bill Cassidy at **19.7%** , with **26.8%** undecided.
A second independent survey by [American Pulse Research](https://julialetlow.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=70758973fc60553eda6683b43&id=d2b83aca02&e=95355a072c), conducted March 20-24, found nearly the same result: Letlow at **31%** , Fleming at **25%** , and Cassidy again in third at **21%**.
**CASSIDY IS COLLAPSING** Bill Cassidy’s standing with Louisiana Republican primary voters is badly damaged. In the BDPC survey, his unfavorable rating stands at **55.1%** , including **42.8%** who view him **very unfavorably**. Among registered Republicans, he receives just **19.0%** support.
The runoff numbers are even worse for Cassidy. In the BDPC poll, Letlow leads Cassidy **50.2% to 24.2%**. In the American Pulse survey, Letlow leads Cassidy by an even wider **54% to 24%** margin.
Cassidy understood from the beginning that he had no real path against the Trump-endorsed candidate, so he made a deliberate choice: spend millions attacking Julia Letlow while leaving Fleming untouched, hoping to fracture the field and avoid the matchup he feared most.
**Thus far, Cassidy and his allies have burned through roughly $15 million in this race, including more than**[**$8 million**](https://julialetlow.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=70758973fc60553eda6683b43&id=e42f80be4c&e=95355a072c)**attacking Julia.** It has not worked, because Louisiana Republicans see right through Cassidy’s lies and have not forgiven his anti-Trump [record](https://julialetlow.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=70758973fc60553eda6683b43&id=da38f91a32&e=95355a072c).
**THE BOTTOM LINE** Julia’s path is clear. She is leading the race, President Trump’s endorsement continues to move voters in her direction, and she is best positioned to grow as the field consolidates. Cassidy remains trapped under the weight of his vote to convict President Trump, and Fleming’s room to operate shrinks as Trump voters come home to the candidate the President endorsed.
###

clean_body: Yesterday, Donald Trump threatened to wipe out “a whole civilization” of 90 million people. | | | Peter, We are in unprecedented waters. Yesterday morning, Donald Trump threatened to wipe out “a whole civilization” of 90 million people. And though a tentative ceasefire appears to have been reached in the time since, we can’t let Trump’s genocidal threats be ignored. He must step down or be removed from office. Congress MUST immediately return to DC to stop this illegal war and take the reins away from this bloodthirsty tyrant. Trump’s threats cannot be overlooked. And his calls for violence cannot be normalized. After he launched this illegal war, it only took him a few hours to bomb a school and slaughter more than 100 young girls.1 And in the weeks since, there have been more than 23,000 Iranian casualties, the vast majority of whom are civilians.2 All to fight a war that nobody wants. A war that nobody voted for. A war that has already cost U.S. taxpayers $44 billion. A war that is happening solely at the behest of tyrants like Trump, Netanyahu, and their corrupt, billionaire friends. We need to put an end to this. We need to do all that we can to bring about an end to this war — and hold those in charge responsible. In solidarity, Team WFP Sources: 1\. , Amnesty International , March 23, 2026 2\. , Reuters , April 2, 2026 Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know.
